jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **NYCSBUS \| WE'RE HIRING!** **Build Smarter Workflows That Help Keep NYC Students Moving** ============================================================== **Join Our Team as An Automation Engineer** ### **NYCSBUS is seeking an Automation Engineer who will automate manual processes, connect our business systems, and develop practical tools that improve efficiency and data accuracy. Working with our Technology team and department leaders, this person will help simplify daily operations and support our mission of providing safe, reliable transportation for NYC students.** If you enjoy using Python, SQL, and APIs to solve practical problems, this role offers the opportunity to see your work in daily use. You will collaborate with the CTO, DevOps and IT colleagues, and department teams to develop and support automations, integrations, and internal tools within agreed priorities and engineering standards. NYCSBUS is a nonprofit school bus operator serving students and families across New York City. Behind every school day are teams coordinating routes, maintaining vehicles, supporting employees, and keeping operations running. **What You Will Do** -------------------- * **Simplify everyday work.** Turn repetitive tasks and spreadsheet\-based processes into reliable automated workflows, working with the people who use them. * **Connect systems.** Build and maintain API integrations and data pipelines that connect business applications, databases, and cloud services. * **Improve data quality.** Develop validations, exception alerts, reconciliations, and approval workflows that reduce manual follow\-up. * **Build useful tools.** Create practical internal applications and evaluate approved AI capabilities where they can improve a defined business process. * **Deliver reliable solutions.** Test, document, monitor, and troubleshoot your work with DevOps and IT colleagues, protecting sensitive information and maintaining appropriate human review. * **Measure the difference.** Track results through reduced processing time, fewer errors, and dependable systems that employees can use confidently. **Projects You Could Work On** ------------------------------ * Identify missing vehicle assignments or conflicting route records before they affect service. * Connect attendance, workforce, and payroll data to flag discrepancies for review. * Use approved AI tools to extract document information or help employees find answers in authorized knowledge sources. **Qualifications For the Role** ------------------------------- * **3\+ years of relevant professional experience** in software development, automation, systems integration, or data engineering. * Strong **Python** skills for automation, data processing, and integrations, plus solid **SQL and relational database** knowledge. * Hands\-on experience with **REST APIs, JSON, authentication, webhooks, and third\-party integrations**. * Experience developing and supporting production workflows, including scheduled or event\-driven processes and cloud services. * Working proficiency in **JavaScript** for scripting or application integrations. * Sound engineering practices, including Git, testing, debugging, logging, and error handling. * Practical familiarity with AI development tools, LLM APIs, or AI\-assisted automation through professional work or demonstrable projects. * The ability to investigate problems independently, explain technical decisions clearly, and collaborate with colleagues across departments. **We value demonstrated engineering ability and completed projects over a specific degree.** You do not need experience with every platform listed below. **Helpful Additional Experience** --------------------------------- * PostgreSQL, AWS, Airflow, or similar database, cloud, and workflow orchestration tools. * Google Workspace APIs, Apps Script, AppSheet, or integrations with systems such as UKG, Fleetio, or Geotab. * LLM\-powered applications, retrieval\-augmented generation, AI output validation, or human approval workflows. * Transportation, logistics, fleet operations, or other environments where reliable operational data matters. **How You Will Make an Impact** ------------------------------- You will work directly with the teams using your solutions and see the results in everyday operations. Early priorities will include understanding existing systems, agreeing on a manageable first project, and delivering a tested, documented improvement. As you learn the environment, you will take on additional projects and strengthen the reliability of existing workflows. **How to Apply** ---------------- Submit your résumé and a brief description of an automation, integration, or software project you helped deliver. **Tell us what problem it solved, what you contributed, and what improved.** You may include a portfolio or GitHub link if available. A written project summary is welcome; please do not share confidential code or information from another employer. **Work Authorization and Equal Opportunity** -------------------------------------------- Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. NYCSBUS does not offer employment visa sponsorship for this position. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** * Annual Salary 105K \- 110K * Comprehensive benefits including health coverage, paid vacation, paid holidays, and PTO. **NYCSBUS is an equal opportunity employer committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.** Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Continuous Improvement Process Engineer, Optical Fiber Operations
jobs.description: **Ready to solve complex manufacturing puzzles?** ------------------------------------------------- What if your analysis today could boost tomorrow’s data speeds across continents? At Prysmian—the global leader in energy and telecom cable systems—we produce the power and data lifelines of modern infrastructure: underground and submarine power cables, and an extensive set of optical fiber, copper, and connectivity solutions. Join 30,000 colleagues in 50\+ countries shaping how the world connects. Make Your Mark at Prysmian Group \- Join Us ### **Consider this scenario** A new fiber design moves from R\&D to pilot. You partner with Operations to map the process, run an SPC review, and launch a designed experiment on extrusion parameters. A defect trend appears—your 5 Why leads to a polymer handling variance. You standardize work, update SOPs, train the team, and the yield climbs past target while cost per unit drops. That’s a win you’ll drive here. ### **Where you’ll focus** * **Process creation and uplift:** Architect, implement, and refine manufacturing processes for fiber optic cable lines. * **Evidence\-based decisions:** Analyze process data to find inefficiencies; apply corrective and preventive actions grounded in SPC and statistical methods. * **Standards and documentation:** Maintain clear, current SOPs and work instructions to lock in best practices. * **Quality collaboration:** Team with QA to resolve defects and uphold product integrity and industry compliance. * **Technology enablement:** Engage vendors on equipment upgrades and maintenance strategies; translate R\&D requirements into production\-ready conditions. * **Lean breakthroughs:** Lead Lean and Six Sigma projects that enhance throughput and reduce waste without sacrificing quality. * **On\-call problem solver:** Provide production support, run root cause analyses, and implement lasting solutions. ### **What you’ll need** * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or related engineering. * **Experience:** Around 1 year in manufacturing covering manufacturing engineering, statistical planning techniques, business systems, project management, and/or quality control (co\-op/internship experience welcomed). * **Nice to have:** Familiarity with extrusion, polymer processing, and optical fiber handling. * **Strengths:** Analytical and problem\-solving mindset; facility with SPC and data analysis tools; grounding in Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma; strong communicator and collaborator; effective at managing multiple projects in a fast\-paced environment. * **Preferred edge:** Telecommunications or fiber optic cable manufacturing background; hands\-on extrusion work, polymer handling, and die design. ### **Work environment** * Manufacturing floor presence with active machinery and production lines. * Expect occasional lifting and extended standing. ### **Skill set and tools we value** * Bachelor's Degree * Data Analysis and Manipulation * Continuous Improvement * Troubleshooting Skills * 5 Why (Root Cause Analysis Method) * Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) * Cell Culture * Process Engineering * Production Optimization * Electrical / Electronic Systems * Lean Manufacturing Principles * Six Sigma Experience * Budgeting / Forecasting Experience * Process Development * SAP (ERP)

jobs.title: Fire & Life Safety Project Manager
jobs.description: Project Manager – Fire Protection \& Life Safety **1 Opening \| New York City Metro VA Facilities (Remote) \| Path to Northeast Operations Lead** HurtVet Fire \& Security Leading Service\-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) with contracts nationwide and multiple offices across the US seeks an experienced Project Manager to lead fire protection and life safety service contracts at government facilities in the New York City metro area. This is primarily a remote role overseeing fire alarm and fire sprinkler/suppression inspection, testing, and maintenance programs at VA medical facilities in the New York City area. As HurtVet's Northeast portfolio grows, this position is expected to take on leadership of our Northeast operations. HurtVet specializes in fire protection, life safety, and physical security services for numerous federal agencies. In This Role You Will * Serve as HurtVet's lead and primary point of contact for fire protection and life safety contracts at government facilities in the NYC area, ensuring all work is performed in accordance with the contract, NFPA codes, and Joint Commission requirements * Plan and schedule all required inspection, testing, and maintenance activity so that code\-required intervals are met across multiple facilities * Manage HurtVet's subcontractor partners and employees from scheduling through documentation and closeout, and coordinate repairs of identified deficiencies * Work with HurtVet's finance department to make sure completed work is accurately billed and invoiced on time * Grow into the lead role for HurtVet's Northeast operations as additional contracts are added to the region Primary Tasks \& ResponsibilitiesContract Management \& Compliance * Develop a working command of each contract's requirements and ensure HurtVet and its partners perform to them, including required test frequencies, reporting deadlines, and deficiency correction timeframes * Hold regular virtual meetings with the customer's facility representatives to review the work plan, findings, documentation, and follow\-up items; attend in person when practical * Interpret and apply NFPA 72, NFPA 25, NFPA 101, and Joint Commission requirements to scheduling, testing, documentation, and deficiency resolution decisions * Support the company's quality control program, including testing schedules, inspection checklists, and a system for tracking and closing out deficiencies * Track contract deliverables and deadlines; identify risks early and escalate issues to HurtVet leadership as needed * When requested, participate (typically virtually) in facility project meetings with third\-party contractors, engineers, and customer staff to provide input on projects that impact fire alarm and suppression systems Scheduling \& Work Coordination * Build and maintain rolling monthly, quarterly, semi\-annual, and annual inspection and testing schedules; submit upcoming schedules to the customer in advance as required * Coordinate site access, system bypasses/impairments, and notifications with facility staff so testing can be performed safely and with minimal disruption to patient care areas * Coordinate repairs of deficiencies found during inspections, including obtaining scope and pricing, securing customer approval, and confirming completion * Coordinate planning for extended system outages, including any required Interim Life Safety Measures (ILSM) and notifications * Serve as the escalation point for urgent service issues during business hours and ensure emergency response is dispatched promptly through the appropriate local partner Subcontractor Management * Schedule required work with subcontractor partners and confirm crews, equipment, and site access are in place * Ensure each subcontractor clearly understands its scope of work, applicable code requirements, site rules, and documentation expectations before work begins * Verify that inspections and tests are properly documented — complete, accurate, device\-level, and submitted within contract timeframes — and that deficiencies are clearly identified and tracked to resolution * Monitor subcontractor performance, quality, and safety; address gaps promptly and professionally * Once work is satisfactorily completed and documented, coordinate billing and invoicing with HurtVet's finance department, including reconciling subcontractor invoices against completed scope Reporting \& Documentation * Review and approve inspection reports, deficiency lists, and device inventories before submission to the customer * Provide daily and periodic status updates to the customer and to HurtVet leadership * Maintain organized, audit\-ready contract files to support customer accreditation surveys and outside inspections * Track hours and costs against contract line items, including any time\-and\-materials or unscheduled repair work Northeast Operations Growth * Help establish repeatable processes, partner relationships, and reporting standards that can scale acr onstrated ability to navigate and apply, NFPA 72 (National Fire Alarm and Signaling Code), NFPA 25 (Inspection, Testing, and Maintenance of Water\-Based Fire Protection Systems), and NFPA 101 (Life Safety Code) * Familiarity with The Joint Commission's accreditation standards for hospitals, particularly the Environment of Care and Life Safety chapters * Proven experience managing subcontractors, including scheduling, scope coordination, quality oversight, and invoice review * Strong organizational and scheduling skills with the ability to manage multiple sites and competing deadlines * Demonstrated ability to manage field work effectively from a remote setting, with a self\-directed, accountable work style * Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable leading customer meetings (virtual and in person) and writing clear reports * Proficiency with MS Office (especially Excel, Outlook, and Teams) and digital inspection/reporting software * Reliable home office setup with high\-speed internet * Ability to travel periodically to VA facilities in the NYC area * Must be able to pass a federal background investigation and obtain and maintain a site\-issued PIV or facility identification badge * Must be able to pass post\-offer drug screen, background check, and reference check Preferred Qualifications (Highly Valued) * Residence in the New York City metro area or elsewhere in the Northeast * NICET Level III or higher in Fire Alarm Systems, Inspection \& Testing of Water\-Based Systems, or a related subfield * Experience managing fire protection contracts in healthcare, VA, or other federal facility environments * Experience leading multi\-site or regional operations, or supervising other project managers or field staff * Working knowledge of NFPA 99 (Health Care Facilities Code) * Experience supporting Joint Commission or other accreditation surveys * Familiarity with Notifier, Edwards/EST, and/or Simplex fire alarm platforms * Experience with jobs.title: Flutter Developer
jobs.description: **Job Summary** As a Flutter Developer, you’ll build and maintain cross\-platform applications that deliver clear, responsive experiences on mobile and web. You’ll collaborate with design, product, and engineering partners to turn user flows and wireframes into reliable features, connect applications to APIs, and support quality throughout the software development life cycle (SDLC). **Duties** * Develop, test, and maintain Flutter applications; apply object\-oriented programming (OOP), responsive design, and sound system architecture. * Build user interfaces and web applications using relevant front\-end development tools and technologies, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Angular, and Bootstrap, as project needs require. * Integrate RESTful APIs, GraphQL, SOAP, JSON, XML, and web services; work with SQL and databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Microsoft SQL Server, and MongoDB. * Collaborate in Agile software development and Scrum workflows; use version control, developer tools, unit testing, and CI/CD to support dependable releases. * Your impact: By delivering accessible, scalable application features, you help users complete tasks smoothly across devices. **Requirements** * Demonstrated software development or application development experience, with Flutter expertise and familiarity with mobile or web development. * Knowledge of UX, UI, web design, developing responsive design projects, scalability, and front\-end technologies; experience with JavaScript frameworks is useful. * Familiarity with relevant tools and platforms such as Git, GitHub, SVN, Jira, Trello, Docker, Jenkins, AWS, Azure, Linux, Visual Studio, and Ansible is welcome. * Exposure to other languages, frameworks, and platforms—including Java, C\#,.NET, ASP.NET Core, Python, Django, PHP, Ruby on Rails, Node.js, Express.js, React Native, Redux, Spring Framework, Tomcat, Drupal, WordPress, and e\-commerce or SEO—is a plus. * Additional experience with MVC, AJAX, jQuery, Sass/SCSS, data visualization, Bash, JSP, React Express, or web services is valued. jobs.title: Founding Engineer, Product
jobs.description: **About Sylvan** ---------------- Sylvan is building autonomous revenue teams. We help B2B companies grow and protect revenue from their existing customers by identifying revenue\-driving signals and deploying agents that act on them at the exact moment, across every account. We work with customers ranging from fast\-growth startups to Fortune 500 enterprises like ServiceNow. Our ambition is to power the top\-line of the economy. We are guided by a core principle: no assholes, high mutual respect. We operate at high intensity, but with deep respect. Direct, honest, and no egos — just a shared obsession to win. We’ve raised $10M\+ from world\-class investors and strategics including TQ Ventures and HubSpot Ventures. We are a fully in\-office company based in Tribeca, New York City. **We will only hire A\-players and are highly willing to go above\-market in ownership, equity, and cash compensation.** We want world\-class builders who are excited by the opportunity to be part of a category\-defining company at the earliest stage. It won’t be easy. We’re going to move fast. But, it’ll be fun. **The Role** ------------ We’re looking for a **Founding Engineer, Product,** who will own the full arc of the core Sylvan product: enabling customers to use it every day, support the companies running on Sylvan already, and keep a fast\-moving codebase clean. You work across product and platform with a small team that writes most of its code with AI tools. This role is in\-person, four days a week. We are a small team, so all engineers own outcomes end to end, talk to customers, and use AI coding tools daily and check its outputs. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Ship features end to end, from ticket to production. * Build the screens customers' teams use every day, starting with account owner review and the manager's queue. * Fix bugs and ship requests for the companies running on Sylvan today. * Write code with AI tools, check what they produce, and review teammates' code. * Talk with customers when a feature needs their input. **What You’ll Bring** --------------------- * 2 to 5 years of professional engineering experience, mostly in TypeScript. * Deep TypeScript across the stack: React or Next.js on the front end, Node and Postgres on the back end. * Shipped features at a startup with paying customers. Big company experience is a plus. * A record of steady output. You ship small changes often and ask early when stuck. * A careful process: you write tests, review your own and others' code, and turn repeat mistakes into lint rules. * Hungry. You want to own a lot, learn fast, and build a company. **Equal Opportunity** --------------------- Sylvan is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities throughout the hiring process \- please let us know if you need any. Compensation Range: $200K \- $300K

jobs.title: HSE Specialist
jobs.description: **Position Summary** The HSE Specialist supports the execution of Health, Safety, and Environmental programs at HULK USA’s Houston manufacturing facility. Reporting to the HSE Manager, this role serves as an onsite HSE partner to employees, Operations, Manufacturing, Engineering, and Facilities. This is a hands\-on, floor\-focused position. The HSE Specialist is expected to spend significant time each day in production and support areas, building relationships, observing work activities, identifying hazards, participating in risk assessments, supporting incident investigations, delivering training, and helping teams work through safety concerns. We are looking for someone with a solid foundation in workplace safety who enjoys working alongside the people performing the work. The right person will bring good judgment, curiosity, strong interpersonal skills, and a willingness to continue developing professionally. This role does not require someone who has independently owned every HSE program. Success comes from understanding safety fundamentals, recognizing risk, communicating effectively, partnering with Operations, following established HSE processes, and knowing when to escalate HSE concerns. **What Success Looks Like** * Build trusted working relationships with employees, supervisors, engineers, technicians, and operational leaders. * Maintain a consistent presence on the manufacturing floor and stay close to the work being performed. * Recognize hazards, ask the right questions, and help teams determine practical ways to reduce risk. * Approach safety as a partner and resource rather than solely as an enforcement function. * Follow incidents and corrective actions through completion instead of stopping at identification of the issue. * Communicate safety concerns clearly and respectfully while remaining open to operational input. * Demonstrate curiosity, sound judgment, accountability, and a willingness to learn. **Responsibilities** **HSE Program Execution \& Operations Support** * Support day\-to\-day HSE activities for the Houston manufacturing facility under the direction of the HSE Manager. * Maintain an active presence in production, assembly, warehouse, testing, maintenance, and other operational areas. * Execute established HSE programs, procedures, and initiatives. * Partner with employees and leaders to identify hazards, understand risk, and determine practical controls. * Participate in workplace inspections, safety observations, job safety analyses, hazard assessments, and process reviews. * Support the development and revision of safe work practices, standard operating procedures, JSAs/JHAs, and related HSE documentation. * Provide practical HSE guidance to employees and supervisors. * Support other operational risk\-management activities as assigned. * Escalate significant hazards, incidents, or compliance concerns to the HSE Manager when appropriate. **Incident Investigation \& Corrective Actions** * Conduct and support investigations involving injuries, near misses, property damage, environmental events, and other HSE\-related incidents. * Gather facts, interview involved employees and witnesses, review work activities, and document investigation findings. * Identify immediate, contributing, and root causes using established investigation methods. * Work with Operations and other stakeholders to develop practical corrective actions. * Track corrective actions through completion and verify follow\-up activities. * Identify recurring issues and communicate trends or improvement opportunities to the HSE Manager. **Training, Coaching \& Employee Engagement** * Coordinate and deliver HSE training for employees and supervisors. * Support new\-hire HSE orientation. * Facilitate or participate in safety meetings, toolbox talks, and employee engagement activities. * Coach employees and leaders on safe work practices in a collaborative and approachable manner. * Encourage employee participation in hazard identification, safety observations, and continuous improvement. * Help employees understand the reason behind HSE requirements and controls, not only the rule itself. **Inspections, Audits \& Risk Assessment** * Conduct routine workplace inspections and safety observations. * Participate in job, equipment, and process risk assessments. * Identify unsafe conditions, behaviors, or process concerns and work with the appropriate teams to address them. * Support internal audits and corrective\-action follow\-up. * Assist with monitoring compliance with company HSE procedures and applicable workplace safety requirements. **HSE Records, Metrics \& Continuous Improvement** * Maintain accurate HSE records, reports, and supporting documentation. * Track assigned HSE action items and corrective actions. * Assist with collecting and reporting leading and lagging HSE performance indicators. * Review observations, incidents, and site\-level trends with the HSE Manager. * Recommend practical improvements relat d, PEC/SafeLand, Veriforce, Avetta, or similar platforms. * Assist with maintaining employee training, certifications, and related compliance documentation. * Help monitor upcoming requirements and expirations and communicate outstanding items to the appropriate teams. * Facilities \& Emergency Preparedness * Partner with the Facilities Manager and HSE Manager on facility\-related safety needs. * Support first\-aid, safety supply, and related facility programs. * Assist with contractor coordination and facility\-related activities from an HSE perspective. * Support emergency preparedness plans, drills, and response activities. * Participate in emergency response, documentation, investigation, and follow\-up activities as needed. **Qualifications** * Approximately 3–5 years of experience in HSE, occupational safety, workplace safety, or a related field. * Experience in manufacturing, industrial, energy, oil and gas, warehousing, logistics, or another operational environment strongly preferred. * Comfortable spending significant time in manufacturing and operational areas and interacting directly with employees performing the work. * Working knowledge of hazard identification, risk assessment, workplace inspections, and safe work practices. * Experience participating in or conducting incident investigations and root\-cause analysis. * Experience supporting HSE training, procedures, inspections, audits, or corrective\-action processes. * Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a collaborative approach to working with Operations and other departments. * Ability to work through situations where the solution is not immediately obvious and seek support when appropriate. * Demonstrated willingness to learn, accept feedback, and continue developing HSE knowledge and skills. * Associate or bachelor’s degree in Occupational Safety, Environmental Health, Safety Management, Industrial Hygiene, Engineering, or a related field preferred. * Relevant professional experience, safety certifications, continuing education, or an equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered. * Valid driver’s license. **Preferred Experience** The following experience is helpful but not required: * Manufacturing hazards involving machine guarding, Lockout/Tagout, welding, material handling, powered industrial trucks, pressure testing, or similar operations. * Environmental compliance, hazardous waste, stormwater, or related environmental activities. * ISNetworld, PEC/SafeLand, Veriforce, Avetta, or similar contractor/customer compliance systems. * Emergency preparedness and response. * Experience partnering with Engineering, Maintenance, Manufacturing, or Facilities teams. * OSHA 500, OSHA 501, ASP, CHST, OHST, GSP, CSHO, or other relevant safety credentials. **Physical Requirements** * Perform work in both office and manufacturing environments. * Spend significant portions of the workday walking through production, warehouse, assembly, testing, maintenance, and other operational areas. * Walk, stand, climb stairs and ladders, bend, stoop, kneel, and access manufacturing work areas. * Occasionally lift and carry up to 25 pounds. * Wear required personal protective equipment and comply with site\-specific safety requirements. * Work in varying indoor and outdoor conditions, including noise, temperature fluctuations, and normal manufacturing\-related hazards. **Additional Information** This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed in this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, qualifications, or working conditions. Responsibilities may change based on business and operational needs. HULK USA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Hardware Product Development Engineer
jobs.description: Illuminect is developing IllumiQ, a compact microdose calibrator building on technology developed at the National Cancer Institute. The product will measure radioactivity in radiopharmaceutical research, supporting applications such as dose preparation and biodistribution studies. We seek an engineer or experienced consultant to guide and carry out hardware development from the NCI technology through successive IllumiQ prototypes. You will work with the PI, software developer, scientific collaborators and vendors to deliver a compact, reliable instrument that can be reproduced and manufactured at practical cost. Responsibilities * Translate measurement needs into hardware requirements, cost targets and acceptance criteria for sensitivity, counting rate, energy measurement, stability and usability. * Evaluate commercial digitizers and modules, and develop custom electronics where needed. Design or oversee multichannel front ends, photodetector interfaces, bias supplies, triggering and signal digitization. * Prepare schematics, review PCB layouts, coordinate fabrication and assembly, and debug boards. Address grounding, noise, crosstalk, power, thermal behavior and electromagnetic interference. * Integrate scintillation detectors, PMT or SiPM readout, electronics, sample holders and enclosure components. Coordinate mechanical design and outsourced fabrication. * Define hardware interfaces and coordinate firmware, device control and data transfer with the software developer; involve specialist FPGA or firmware support when needed. * Characterize gain, spectral response, timing, saturation and count losses. Support calibrated radioactive\-source testing with project laboratories and collaborators. * Use bench and application results to improve subsequent prototypes. Maintain design records, issue tracking and verification evidence with the PI. * Prepare the bill of materials, assembly documentation, test fixtures and production checks needed for repeatable builds, servicing and supplier handoff. Qualifications * Degree in electrical engineering, applied physics, instrumentation or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * Demonstrated hands\-on development of detector electronics or comparable low\-noise, multichannel scientific instrumentation. * Experience with PCB design and bring\-up, oscilloscopes, signal generators and systematic hardware troubleshooting. * Ability to work independently, document decisions and coordinate effectively with software developers, scientists and external suppliers. Preferred experience Experience with scintillators, PMTs or SiPMs; radiation spectroscopy or counting; high\-speed acquisition; embedded control or FPGA systems; compact instrument packaging; and moving prototypes toward small\-volume manufacturing. Expected deliverables Expected deliverables include an agreed hardware specification, integrated working prototypes, documented performance tests and a controlled design package suitable for subsequent builds. Anticipated start: Summer 2027, subject to the SBIR award schedule. Work arrangement: Part\-time employment, consulting or contract work considered. Hours, scope, milestones and engagement terms will be agreed based on mutual fit. Funding contingency: This is a prospective position contingent on Illuminect receiving an SBIR grant and having funding available for the role. Engagement and the start date will be confirmed after funding is secured and mutually acceptable terms are agreed. Pay: $105,000\.00 \- $129,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Flexible schedule * Health insurance * Paid time off * Retirement plan Work Location: Hybrid remote in New Jersey

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Machine Learning Research Engineer I
jobs.description: **Member of Technical Staff \- Machine Learning Research Engineer I** San Francisco Bay Area \| Bellevue, Washington **About AIVista** NTT DATA AIVista, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of NTT DATA, is based in Silicon Valley. We develop AI products for enterprises operating in complex regulatory environments. We work with NTT DATA Inc., NTT DATA Japan, and NTT DOCOMO to deploy systems for NTT clients. Our clients combine AIVista's product AI expertise with NTT DATA's industry knowledge and systems\-integration experience. **The Role** The Machine Learning Research Engineer works closely with AIVista scientists to turn promising research into dependable capabilities for enterprise use. You will develop a deep understanding of each method, its assumptions, supporting evidence, and known limitations, then focus on the work required to make it reproducible, robust, scalable, and maintainable. You will test how methods behave across realistic workloads, varied domains and data, difficult edge cases, and operational constraints; improve their reliability and efficiency; and integrate them into product capabilities with the traceability, controls, and review boundaries required in regulated industries. This work spans reinforcement learning, simulation environments, formal methods, autoformalization, and AIVista's data, rule, action, and process ontologies. **Responsibilities** * Work with scientists to understand each method's assumptions, supporting evidence, known failure modes, and acceptance criteria for broader use. * Reproduce research results across independent runs and settings, characterize sources of variance, and identify behavior that depends on a narrow dataset, model version, configuration, or operating condition. * Refactor and extend research prototypes without changing their scientific meaning; make tradeoffs explicit and validate each material change against agreed baselines. * Design stress tests, adversarial cases, counterfactual scenarios, rare events, and out\-of\-distribution evaluations that expose brittle behavior before product use. * Scale methods from research\-sized examples to realistic workflow length, data volume, concurrency, and domain variation while controlling latency and cost. * Improve reliability, calibration, constraint adherence, recovery behavior, and consistency, and determine whether measured gains generalize beyond the original research cases. * Advance synthetic environments, workflow simulations, and agent evaluations from research prototypes into stable, versioned assets that represent exceptions, human review, governed actions, and external\-system behavior. * Harden autoformalization and ontology\-backed methods so source traceability, rule and process semantics, validation evidence, and governed actions remain correct as content and scale change. * Preserve independent checks and acceptance evidence as models, code, data, ontologies, and process definitions evolve. * Feed findings back to Science, including failures that require changes to the problem formulation, learning method, reward or constraint design, formalization approach, or evaluation strategy. * Partner with product and engineering teams to define operating limits, monitoring, regression tests, release criteria, rollback plans, and ownership for capabilities moving into production. * Build the durable software and automation required for reproducible experimentation, repeated evaluation, efficient scaling, and safe product integration, and maintain clear documentation for future contributors. **Qualifications** **Basic** * Master's degree in computer science, machine learning, artificial intelligence, software engineering, applied mathematics, or a related field. * At least 5 years of experience taking machine\-learning or research prototypes toward reliable, sustained use at realistic scale. * Demonstrated experience improving the reproducibility, robustness, scalability, or operating efficiency of a research capability, supported by clear measurements and failure analysis. * Strong software\-engineering judgment, including the ability to restructure prototypes, isolate assumptions, design effective tests, diagnose performance and reliability problems, and leave maintainable code and documentation. * Working knowledge of machine learning, statistical evaluation, experimental design, and failure analysis, with the ability to implement methods from papers and reason about how engineering changes affect the method. * Experience evaluating behavior across changing data, model versions, workloads, and operating conditions rather than relying on a single benchmark result. * Ability to collaborate closely with scientists, engineers, product teams, and domain experts to move research capabilities toward reliable use in regulated environments. **Preferred** * Experience hardening reinforcement\-learning environments, agent systems, workflow simulations, digital twins, or other sequential\-decision methods for use beyond research demonstrations. * Experience evaluating long\-horizon agents, verifier\-guided methods, or reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards under adversarial, rare, or changing conditions. * Experience scaling ontology\-backed, knowledge\-graph, rule, process, or provenance\-aware methods while preserving semantic correctness and source traceability. * Experience taking formal specifications, autoformalization, program analysis, or verification methods from research prototypes into repeatable software\-development workflows. * Experience diagnosing distribution shift, specification gaming, reward hacking, data leakage, calibration failures, or regressions that appear only at larger scale. * Experience establishing operating limits, monitoring, release evidence, and safe change practices for machine\-learning or decision systems. * Experience deploying AI or decision systems in regulated or high\-stakes industries such as insurance, financial services, healthcare, or public\-sector operations. * A record of technical impact through shipped systems, research publications, patents, benchmarks, open\-source work, or widely used internal research capabilities. **Benefits** * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) plan * Significant company Health Savings Account contribution * Paid holidays and flexible paid time off **Compensation** The estimated base salary range for this role is $300,000\-$400,000 USD. The salary for the successful applicant will depend on job\-related factors such as education, training, work experience, business needs, and market demands. This range may be modified in the future. Total compensation also includes variable pay in the form of an annual target bonus and other cash incentives, with a combined potential of up to 100% of base salary.. **Equal Opportunity Employment** NTT DATA AIVista is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, reproductive health decisions, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Senior Resources Geologist
jobs.description: **Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.** At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations. We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us. **Job Description** **AECOM** is seeking an experienced **Senior Resource Geologist** to join our U.S. West Region Mining and Minerals team. This position will focus primarily on advanced geological modeling, mineral resource estimation, and technical evaluation of mineral deposits across a diverse portfolio of mining and exploration projects. The successful candidate will have demonstrated hands\-on experience developing three\-dimensional geological models, performing mineral resource estimates, and analyzing complex geological datasets. This individual will contribute technical expertise to multidisciplinary mining projects, supporting mineral exploration, resource evaluations, feasibility studies, and mine development activities. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, advanced proficiency with industry\-standard geological modeling software, and the ability to independently develop and validate technically defensible geological models and mineral resource estimates. **Key Responsibilities** * Develop, interpret, and validate complex three\-dimensional geological models, including lithological, structural, alteration, and mineralization domains using industry\-standard modeling software. * Perform mineral resource estimation activities, including geological domaining, statistical and geostatistical analysis, compositing, block model development, grade interpolation, resource classification, and model validation. * Compile, analyze, and validate exploration and geological datasets, including drillhole information, assay results, geological databases, and quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC) data to support accurate geological interpretations and resource estimates. * Develop, update, and independently evaluate mineral resource models for exploration projects, operating mines, feasibility studies, and technical due diligence assignments, including assessment of geological uncertainty and resource estimation risks. * Prepare mineral resource estimation documentation, technical reports, and supporting analyses in accordance with applicable industry reporting standards, including NI 43\-101, S\-K 1300, and JORC Code requirements. * Provide geological modeling and resource estimation expertise to multidisciplinary project teams, collaborating with mining engineers, geotechnical engineers, and exploration professionals to support mine planning, project evaluations, and technical studies. * Support technical reviews and project investigations, including geological interpretation, exploration targeting, resource model reconciliation, site investigations, and evaluation of geological and mineral resource data. * Comfortable participating in extended site assignments ranging from several days to multiple weeks at remote exploration\-mining operations. May require: + Extended shifts + Rotational schedules + Travel between mine sites + Remote and international assignments + Weekend or holiday travel when project demands require **Qualifications** **Minimum Requirements** * BS in Geology of related field and 8 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education. * Registered Professional Geologist (PG) license. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master's degree in Geology, Mineral Resource Evaluation, or a closely related discipline. * 10\+ years of progressive professional experience in resource geology, mineral resource estimation, or geological modeling within the mining industry. * Advanced proficiency with geological modeling and resource estimation software, particularly Leapfrog Geo, Leapfrog Edge, MinePlan (MineSight), Vulcan, or comparable platforms. * Demonstrated experience developing geological domains, block models, and mineral resource estimates using appropriate statistical and geostatistical methodologies, including variography, grade interpolation, resource classification, and model validation. * Experience preparing, reviewing, or contributing substantially to mineral resource estimates and technical reports in accordance with NI 43\-101, S\-K 1300, and/or JORC Code reporting standards, including experience serving as a Qualified Person (QP) or Competent Person (CP). * Experience evaluating mineral resources across multiple commodities or deposit types, including precious metals, base metals, and critical minerals, as well as conducting technical due diligence and resource model reviews. * Strong understanding of geological database management, exploration QA/QC, drillhole data validation, geological interpretation, and mineral resource estimation uncertainty. * Strong technical writing and communication skills, with the ability to present complex geological models, estimation methodologies, and technical findings to multidisciplinary project teams and clients. * Willingness and ability to travel up to 15% to mining and exploration project sites, including remote locations. **Additional Information** * There is no relocation assistance associated with this role. * There is no sponsorship for this role, now or in the future. * **THIS POSTING IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND AECOM INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY MARCH 1, 2027** At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired diverse needs of our employees. jobs.title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Training Instructor
jobs.description: **Position Overview** --------------------- Agile Business Concepts, LLC (ABC) is seeking an experienced **Artificial Intelligence (AI) Training Instructor** to support a potential federal training program for the Department of Veterans Affairs Technology Acquisition Center. The ideal candidate will possess expertise in **Generative AI, prompt engineering, federal acquisition processes, and adult learning methodologies**, with demonstrated experience delivering interactive, instructor\-led training to government professionals. The instructor will develop and deliver practical AI training designed to help federal contracting officers, contract specialists, engineers, program managers, and business professionals responsibly integrate AI into acquisition workflows. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Design and deliver live, virtual instructor\-led AI training sessions for federal government professionals. * Teach generative AI fundamentals, large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and responsible AI practices. * Demonstrate how approved AI tools can support acquisition planning, technical requirements development, document analysis, and contract administration. * Provide hands\-on exercises using documents, spreadsheets, templates, and realistic federal acquisition scenarios. * Train participants to develop effective prompts, refine AI\-generated outputs, and validate results against authoritative sources. * Incorporate applicable Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) and Veterans Affairs Acquisition Regulation (VAAR) concepts into training scenarios. * Address AI risks, including inaccurate outputs, data privacy, confidentiality, and protection of sensitive government information. * Develop accessible course materials, presentations, practical exercises, and participant reference guides. * Prepare a Prompt Starter Library, Command Quick Reference, Document Workflow Cheat Sheet, and Responsible Use Checklist. * Support participant attendance tracking, course evaluations, training completion certificates, and Continuing Learning Point (CLP) coordination. * Collaborate with ABC's program management team to meet client training schedules and deliverable requirements. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Education, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. * Minimum **5 years of relevant professional experience** in AI, information technology, technical training, or federal acquisition support. * Demonstrated hands\-on experience with generative AI tools and prompt engineering. * Experience developing and delivering live, instructor\-led technical or professional training. * Strong understanding of AI capabilities, limitations, hallucinations, and responsible\-use principles. * Ability to explain complex AI concepts to nontechnical audiences. * Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, and instructional\-design skills. * Familiarity with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and virtual training platforms. * Ability to develop clear, accessible instructional materials and hands\-on learning exercises. * Ability to meet federal client deadlines and coordinate effectively with program stakeholders. **Highly Preferred Qualifications** ----------------------------------- * Previous experience training federal government personnel, particularly contracting officers, contract specialists, or acquisition professionals. * Working knowledge of **FAR, VAAR, federal procurement processes, and acquisition documentation**. * Experience using generative AI for requirements drafting, document comparison, summarization, market research, and acquisition workflow improvement. * Experience with ChatGPT Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot, Azure OpenAI, or comparable enterprise AI platforms. * Familiarity with federal AI governance, data protection, and Section 508 accessibility requirements. * Experience supporting VA, DoD, or other federal civilian agencies. * Relevant certifications in AI, cloud technologies, instructional design, or federal acquisition. * Experience preparing training assessments, course evaluations, certificates, and CLP documentation. **Training Delivery Expectations** ---------------------------------- * Deliver interactive, real\-time virtual training sessions. * Accommodate approximately **25 participants per class**. * Provide practical demonstrations and guided exercises. * Support course scheduling, student enrollment changes, and post\-training reporting. * Be available for training delivery anticipated through **June 2027**, subject to contract award and government scheduling.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Risk
jobs.description: **About Airwallex** ------------------- Airwallex is the AI\-native financial operating system for a real\-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85\+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia\-Pacific. We're co\-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder\-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. **How you'll make impact** -------------------------- You’ll build and enhance Airwallex’s payment products and transaction systems using Java or Kotlin. You’ll design and develop components on our microservice framework, with a focus on scalable and reliable services. You’ll improve the systems that protect Airwallex’s products and services, using technologies such as graph databases, machine learning and LLMs to support risk management. * Drive architectural improvements across distributed, high\-concurrency systems by experimenting with new technologies and applying sound engineering judgment. * Improve the reliability and scalability of payment products, transaction systems and risk\-management capabilities. * Build services that support the detection and mitigation of evolving fraud risks across Airwallex’s products. * Partner with senior engineers to raise software engineering practices and coding standards. * Mentor less\-experienced engineers and help strengthen the team’s technical capability. You'll be in our Seattle office 3 days a week. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- ### **Essentials** * More than four years of core Java development experience and more than five years of experience building internet applications, large financial systems or e\-commerce platforms. * More than three years of experience developing risk or payment platforms. * A bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related discipline. * Strong proficiency in Java, including Java multithreading, high concurrency, I/O, NIO and network communication. * Experience with common design patterns and the design and development of large\-scale, distributed, high\-concurrency, high\-load and highly available systems. * Strong knowledge of server technologies, including service\-response and data\-query optimisation, service quality and high\-concurrency and high\-availability problem solving. * Familiarity with Spring, Spring Boot and RESTful services. * Experience with Gradle, Maven or other build tools. * Familiarity with JSON and XML. ### **Preferred** * In\-depth knowledge of risk\-management strategies and fraud\-detection techniques, particularly in financial services or fintech. * Familiarity with graph databases and their use in pattern and anomaly detection. * Experience with machine\-learning models and frameworks for predictive risk analytics. * Familiarity with real\-time data\-streaming technologies such as Apache Kafka or Flink. * Strong data\-analytics skills, with experience using ClickHouse, Spark or NoSQL databases for large\-scale data processing and risk analysis. * Advanced problem\-solving skills, including experience with incident response and risk\-mitigation planning. * Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach to working with teammates and partners. **You'll thrive here if** ------------------------- * You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway. * You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it. * You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken. * You enjoy working closely with people across multiple countries and time zones as part of one connected, global team, including flexing your hours occasionally to make that connection work. * You value in\-person collaboration and are happy being in the office five days a week. **Learn more about your team** ------------------------------ Risk Platform builds the decisioning infrastructure that sits between Airwallex and every dollar that moves through it, protecting 150,000\+ businesses moving over US$260 billion a year across 150\+ countries and 60\+ currencies, and deciding, often in milliseconds, whether a new signup is real, a payment is safe, or a login is who they claim to be. The hard part is that fraud evolves fast, and every decision carries a two\-sided cost: miss an attack and money is lost, over\-block and a legitimate business can't get paid. We build this with streaming pipelines processing billions of events a day, graph databases exposing coordinated fraud rings, ML models scoring every transaction, and LLM agents that triage alerts. You don't need a fintech background, just an appetite for adversarial systems problems where the scoreboard is measured in dollars. If you want to help scale one of the world's fastest\-growing financial platforms safely, this is the team. **Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third\-Party Recruiters** -------------------------------------------------------------- *To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @**airwallex.com* *email address. Please apply only through* *careers.airwallex.com* *or our official LinkedIn page.* *Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.* **Equal opportunity** --------------------- Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: AI Automation Engineer (Orange, CA/Hyrbid)
jobs.description: Alignment Health is breaking the mold in conventional health care, committed to serving seniors and those who need it most: the chronically ill and frail. It takes an entire team of passionate and caring people, united in our mission to put the senior first. We have built a team of talented and experienced people who are passionate about transforming the lives of the seniors we serve. In this fast\-growing company, you will find ample room for growth and innovation alongside the Alignment Health community. Working at Alignment Health provides an opportunity to do work that really matters, not only changing lives but saving them. Together. The Artificial Intelligence \& Automation Engineer is a hands\-on technical contributor on the Data \& Technology Solutions team, responsible for designing, building, and deploying intelligent AI systems and automated workflows that drive operational efficiency and elevate the quality of care for our Medicare Advantage members. You will partner closely with AI Scientists, Data Engineers, Product Managers, Clinical Operations, and Application Engineering teams to translate complex business problems — from claims processing and prior authorization to member communication and revenue integrity — into scalable, production\-grade solutions. This role directly influences our ability to reduce administrative burden, accelerate payment accuracy, and create smarter, faster member experiences.**Job Duties / Responsibilities** * Build distributed, cloud\-native systems for enterprise workloads. Design and build services, APIs, and microservices that run reliably at scale in a regulated environment. Apply solid distributed systems fundamentals: fault tolerance, retries and idempotency, queuing and eventing, caching, and horizontal scaling. * Build hybrid infrastructure that bridges cloud and non\-cloud systems. Build integrations with non\-API data sources, including flat files, legacy databases, EDI feeds, mainframes, and streaming data, as well as multimodal data such as documents, images, and audio. Design for environments where not everything is cloud\-native or API\-first. * Build and operate CI/CD, containerization, and deployment pipelines. Containerize and deploy using Docker and Kubernetes. * Build CI/CD pipelines for reproducible, reliable releases, and apply infrastructure\-as\-code practices across the systems you own. * Build data and automation pipelines. Build ETL and orchestration pipelines using tools such as Airflow or Prefect. Automate high\-volume, repetitive processes using RPA platforms (e.g., UiPath, Power Automate), with proper error handling, fault tolerance, and alerting. * Apply AI/ML to production systems (applied, not research). Build and serve inferencing pipelines (batch, real\-time, streaming) for models handed off from AI Sciences, for workloads such as claims processing, risk adjustment, and member communication. Integrate LLMs into workflows using prompt engineering and RAG, and use agentic frameworks to automate multi\-step processes. This is applied integration and serving work, not model research or training. Support the Databricks platform used by AI Sciences. Help productionize models and pipelines built on Databricks, including Delta Lake, MLflow, and Unity Catalog. * Support CI/CD, orchestration, and access controls that let Databricks\-based work move into production. * Build with cost and reliability in mind. Treat cost per inference and infrastructure spend as engineering considerations, not an afterthought. Build monitoring, alerting, and drift detection to catch issues before they affect member outcomes. * Collaborate cross\-functionally. Partner with AI Scientists, Product Managers, clinical stakeholders, and business analysts to turn requirements into working systems. Contribute to code reviews and documentation, and provide informal mentorship to peers. **Supervisory Responsibilities** This is an individual contributor role with no direct supervisory responsibility. The engineer is expected to provide informal technical mentorship to peers and junior team members through code reviews, documentation, and collaborative problem\-solving. **Job Requirements** **Experience** *Required:* * 3–5 years of professional experience in software engineering with a demonstrated focus on AI/ML, data science, or intelligent process automation * Hands\-on experience building and deploying machine learning models in a production cloud environment (AWS, Azure, or GCP) * Experience integrating systems with non\-API and multimodal data sources * Experience in a regulated industry (healthcare, insurance, or financial services) * Hands\-on experience applying AI/ML models or LLMs in a production system (integration/serving, not necessarily training) *Preferred:* * Experience integrating systems with non\-API and multimodal data sources * Experience in a regulated industry (healthcare, insurance, or financial services) * Some hands\-on experience applying AI/M  (AWS SageMaker, Azure AI, or Google Vertex AI); training or certification equivalent accepted *Preferred:* * Completion of formal certification or coursework in MLOps, cloud AI platforms, responsible AI, or agentic AI development * Certification in RPA platforms (UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Microsoft Power Automate) **Skills \& Competencies** **Technical / Role\-Specific Skills** * **AI/ML Engineering:** Proficiency in Python (primary), with strong command of ML frameworks including PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit\-learn, and Hugging Face Transformers; experience with LLM\-based frameworks including RAG pipelines, vector databases, and agentic frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph * **Intelligent Process Automation:** Hands\-on experience with at least one RPA platform (UiPath, Power Automate, Automation Anywhere) and at least one orchestration tool (Apache Airflow, Prefect, or n8n); ability to analyze processes, identify automation opportunities, and estimate ROI * **Cloud AI Platforms:** Hands\-on experience with AWS SageMaker, Azure AI / Document Intelligence, Google Cloud Vertex AI, or Databricks; familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines for ML workflows * **Data Engineering \& MLOps:** Ability to build and maintain ETL and feature pipelines; proficiency with GitHub and model versioning tools (MLflow or equivalent); working knowledge of SQL for data transformation and workflow support * **Healthcare \& Regulatory Literacy:** Working knowledge of HIPAA compliance and data security requirements in regulated healthcare environments; familiarity with healthcare data standards including HL7 FHIR and ICD\-10/CPT as applied to AI/ML systems * **API Design \& System Integration:** Experience integrating AI models and automation services into enterprise applications via REST APIs and microservices; ability to collaborate with software engineering teams to ensure production\-grade reliability * **Responsible AI Principles:** Awareness of and commitment to ethical AI practices including bias detect **Essential Physical Functions:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. The employee frequently lifts and/or moves up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Data Platform
jobs.description: *Arcadia is dedicated to happier, healthier days for all. We believe that there is a better healthcare world—one powered by data. Our platform transforms complex, diverse data into a unified foundation for health, helping organizations deliver better care, boost revenue, and lower costs.* *We're a team of fiercely driven individuals committed to making healthcare more sustainable—and we're looking for passionate people to help us get there.* *For more information, visit* *arcadia.io**.* **Why This Role Is Important to Arcadia** Arcadia's petabyte\-scale data platform is at the heart of everything the company does; everyone from our external customers to our engineers, from our analysts to our sales team, depends on it. They don't just use it; they build on it. This data platform needs to enable a shared ownership model, so the platform team can scale and internal teams can move fast. This role sets how we build and run it. The role reports directly to the VP of Engineering. **What Success Looks Like** The data platform provides building blocks, from catalog and pipelines to databases, queues, and storage, that come pre\-wired with connectivity, logging, metrics, tracing, alerts, encryption, access controls, backups, and cost tags—all with sensible defaults. Internal teams own and change their pipelines, environments, alerts, and SLOs. When something breaks, the owning team sees it first, traces it to the root cause, and addresses it themselves. They see their own quality numbers and cloud spend, and act on them. Data platform engineers spend their time building capabilities, not working tickets. ### **What You'll Be Doing** * Partner with **internal teams** to prioritize, implement, and roll out features they depend on—from enabling self\-service ETL authoring to provisioning new data stores, from establishing data quality metrics to optimizing performance. * **Evaluate new technologies** and architectures, prototype them, and roll them out as new capabilities across the platform. * Write a meaningful share of the production code. * Work closely with our **AWS infrastructure** team on the platform's network, compute, and security. * Push **quality** attributes into the platform, especially as AI increases the volume of changes. We need the platform itself to be stable, resilient, performant, and cost\-effective. Internal teams that build on it need to be able to configure their own SLIs/SLOs and focus on data quality. * Run the platform as an internal **product**: find what slows teams down, pick the few capabilities worth building, publish the roadmap, and measure adoption, delivery speed, stability, and developer satisfaction. * Drive **migrations** to completion: track usage, automate instead of handing out checklists, push through the final 20%, and sunset legacy systems. * Set technical **direction**, evolve the platform, and **coach** other engineers through design partnership and review. * Building data engineering tooling on top of our internal AI platform. ### **What You'll Bring** * Deep experience in **data engineering**—from columnar stores to data lakes, from distributed processing to SQL optimization. * Expertise in **software engineering**—CI/CD, testing, architecture, source control, automation, observability, modularity and reuse, and fluency in Python, Java, or Scala. * **Modern data stack** experience (e.g. data contracts and data products, dbt, Spark, Dagster, Iceberg and Parquet, notebooks and BI, data catalogs and data quality). * Strong **AWS experience** since the platform is built on its network, storage, and compute primitives. * Experience **building with AI**. * **Reliability** you've owned: SLOs, observability, on\-call, and incident response. * Current, hands\-on **production coding**, the habit of figuring things out (research, spike, deliver), and relentless **pragmatism** about what's worth building. * A track record of **driving change** across the org. ### **Would Love for You to Have** * **Regulated**\-data experience (HIPAA, PHI, SOC 2 or HITRUST environments). * A **public voice** through talks, writing, or open source. * Experience turning a data engineering team into a **product\-minded platform team** complete with processes, stakeholder management, and a roadmap. * Experience building platform **support that scales**: support tiers, office hours, docs, shared ownership principles, escalation processes, and developer advocacy. * No healthcare background required. ### **What You'll Get** * The opportunity to **shape Arcadia's data platform** and its direction for years to come. * **Direct influence** on how Arcadia's engineering org works on a daily basis through tooling, patterns, and standards. * **Remote\-first** across the US, with in\-person hubs growing in Boston, DC, and NYC. * **A flexible culture with personality and heart**, named a Built In 2026 Best Place to Work. * Work that shows up in **patients' lives**. $250,000 \- $350,000 a year **About Arcadia** Arcadia.io helps innovative providers and payers across the country transform healthcare to reduce cost while improving patient health. We do this by aggregating large amounts of disparate data, applying algorithms to identify opportunities to provide better patient care, and making those opportunities actionable by physicians at the point of care in near\-real time. We are passionate about helping our customers drive meaningful outcomes. We are growing fast and have emerged as a market leader in the highly competitive population health management software market and have been recognized by industry analysts KLAS, IDC, Forrester, and Chilmark for our leadership. For a better sense of our brand and products, please explore our website. **Protect Yourself** If you have concerns about the authenticity of a job offer or recruitment\-related communication claiming to be from Arcadia, we encourage you to verify by contacting us directly at (781\) 202\-3600 and select option 3\. For more information, visit our website. *This position is responsible for following all Security policies and procedures in order to protect all PHI under Arcadia's custodianship as well as Arcadia Intellectual Properties. For any security\-specific roles, the responsibilities would be further defined by the hiring manager.* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Engineering Designer
jobs.description: Job ID 46068 Date Posted 2026\-11\-23 Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets. We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together. **Role description:** Arcadis is looking for a **ITS** Engineer with interest in intelligent transportation systems, traffic engineering, and transit operations and design to join our Seattle, WA team to assist our growing Transit/ITS group in developing Bus Rapid Transit (BRT), Traffic and Transit Systems, Integrated Corridor Management (ICM) and Active Traffic Management (ATM) policies, utilizing data to identify operational and safety needs, preparing design plans, and transit system planning. We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills\-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together. You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you. Together, we can create a lasting legacy. Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy. Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion \& Belonging We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. We are an equal opportunity employer. We are dedicated to a policy of non\-discrimination in employment on any basis including race, creed, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, citizenship status, disability, veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by law. Arcadis offers benefits for full time and part time positions. These benefits include medical, dental, and vision, EAP, 401K, STD, LTD, AD\&D, life insurance, paid parental leave, reward \& recognition program and optional benefits including wellbeing benefits, adoption assistance and tuition reimbursement. We offer nine paid holidays and 15 days PTO that accrue per year. The salary range for this position is $65,578\- $98,336\. Actual salaries will vary and are based on several factors, such as experience, education, budget, internal equity, project and location. \#LI\-RG2 \#Mobility\-ANA\-Jobs \#EarlycareersANA Important: Recruitment scams impersonating Arcadis. Stay vigilant for suspicious activities by individuals falsely claiming to be Arcadis’ recruiters. Arcadis will never ask you for payment at any stage of our recruitment process. If you’re suspicious about a recruiter’s identity, email us at **contact\-us@arcadis.com** with “Suspected Fraud” in the subject line. **Reminder: No unsolicited submissions. Direct applications only.** Arcadis does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies. No fees will be paid for any such submissions. All candidates must apply directly through our official channels. Thank you for helping us maintain a safe recruitment process.

reusable, and embedded in delivery workflows **What you'll do** **Enterprise Data Architecture \& Modeling** * Define and evolve enterprise conceptual and logical data models for key business domains * Establish clear representations of business entities, relationships, and domain boundaries * Provide architectural guidance that promotes consistency while supporting team autonomy * Apply jobs.title: NOC Network Security Engineer
jobs.description: Job Type Full\-time Description **POSITION SUMMARY:** The Managed Services Network Security Engineer is responsible for monitoring, maintaining, and securing client network environments. This role requires hands\-on expertise across multiple vendors and technologies, with the ability to independently execute maintenance windows and implement changes. The engineer proactively responds to incidents, manages configurations, and ensures systems remain up to date and secure against emerging threats. Additionally, the position supports client onboarding, reporting, and continuous improvement of network health and performance.
