NOC Manager of Client Services * Develop detailed implementation plans, including validation steps, rollback procedures, and risk assessments. * Review proposed changes with clients to ensure alignment with business and technical requirements. * Execute changes during scheduled maintenance windows with minimal supervision. * Follow established Change Advisory Board (CAB) processes for documentation, approval, and tracking. * Clearly communicate expected service impacts, risks, and outcomes to stakeholders prior to execution. * Maintain configuration standards and ensure consistency across multi\-client environments. **Release \& Vulnerability Management** * Plan and execute software upgrades, firmware updates, and patching activities across supported platforms. * Maintain awareness of vendor\-recommended code versions and lifecycle statuses. * Proactively identify and remediate security vulnerabilities in client environments. * Coordinate emergency patching efforts in response to critical vulnerabilities or zero\-day threats. * Validate system stability and performance following upgrades or patches. * Document upgrade procedures and outcomes for future reference and standardization. **Client Onboarding \& Integration** * Assist in onboarding new clients by staging and deploying network and security appliances. * Integrate client environments into monitoring and management platforms, ensuring full visibility. * Establish secure connectivity between client environments and managed service infrastructure. * Troubleshoot and resolve onboarding issues related to device communication, telemetry, or configuration * Document client environments in detail, including network topology, device inventories, configurations, and access requirements. * Develop and maintain client\-specific documentation to support ongoing operations and troubleshooting efforts. * Create and contribute to knowledge base articles based on onboarding activities, common issues, and **Reporting \& Environment Health** * Generate and review monthly and quarterly reports on client network and security posture. * Analyze device performance, security events, and compliance with best practices. * Identify trends, risks, and areas for improvement within client environments. * Proactively address actionable findings before they result in service degradation or outages. * Present findings and recommendations to internal stakeholders or clients as needed. **Administrative \& Operational Responsibilities** * Provide regular updates to clients regarding open incidents, service requests, and ongoing work. * Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date ticket documentation, including work performed and resolution details. * Track time and activities within the ServiceNow platform in accordance with operational requirements. * Submit weekly timesheets and ensure all work is properly accounted for. * Adhere to defined SLAs, escalation procedures, and internal operational standards. **Multi\-Vendor Network Security Support** * Provide support across a diverse set of networking and security vendors, including but not limited to: * Cisco * Meraki * Palo Alto Networks * Fortinet * infrastructure * Wireless LAN Controllers (WLCs) * Wireless Access Points (cloud\-managed and controller\-based) * Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) * Network access control and segmentation technologies * Additional technologies will be considered as business opportunities arise **Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have Skills** * Experience with Cisco Umbrella (DNS\-layer security) * Familiarity with AWS networking and security constructs (VPCs, security groups, routing) * Scripting or automation experience (Python, API integrations) * Experience with Cisco ThousandEyes for network visibility and performance monitoring * Exposure to infrastructure\-as\-code or automation frameworks is a plus Perform additional duties as required that support the responsibilities of the Client Services management function. jobs.title: Head of Machine Learning Research
jobs.description: **At Bayer, we believe work should matter. Every day, our teams push toward a future where "Health for all, Hunger for none" is within reach, and every role, from the lab to the field to the boardroom, helps us get there. We give people the ownership to shape outcomes, the support to grow through new skills and experiences, and a global community where different perspectives are valued. If you want your work to count and the room to become your best, you'll find it here.** **We’re changing the way we work at Bayer, for higher productivity, faster innovation, and better results. We call it Dynamic Shared Ownership (DSO). Learn more about what DSO will mean for you in your new role here** **https://www.bayer.com/en/strategy/strategy** **Head of Machine Learning Research** ===================================== Following Bayer’s ambition of “Health for All, Hunger for None”, we are seeking a **scientific and technical leader** to advance machine learning–enabled breakthroughs across our drug discovery portfolio. As a member of the Data Science \& AI leadership team, you will define and deliver the models, platforms, and ways of working that accelerate innovation across target discovery, molecular design, disease understanding, and clinical development. This is a **scientific and strategic leadership role** . You will lead the development and application of modern machine learning methods to complex, high\-dimensional scientific data. You will set a multi\-year technical roadmap, build and lead a team of approximately 25 global scientists and engineers, and ensure that machine learning capabilities translate into better project decisions and faster progression to drugs that impact patient lives. Success in this role requires deep fluency in contemporary machine learning, combined with a practical understanding of the realities of drug discovery. **YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES** The primary responsibilities of this role, Head of Machine Learning Research, are to: **Strategy and Technical Direction** * Co\-own the vision, roadmap, and investment case for ML\-driven transformation of Bayer’s Pharma pipeline. * Make build/buy/partner decisions; evaluate partners, models, and external platforms with rigor. Set the standard for how models are validated, benchmarked, applied, and retired. * **Delivery into Discovery Projects** * Drive the integration of machine learning across the end\-to\-end R\&D pipeline by partnering with multidisciplinary teams. Ensure models are delivered as reliable, supported products that lab\-based scientists broadly use. * **Platform and Data Foundation** * Develop the foundational AI capabilities that convert multimodal life science data into scientific insight, predictive models, intelligent design, and decision\-making tools across R\&D. * Ensure robust data foundations through close collaboration with data engineering and scientific teams. Establish MLOps and AI governance practices that deliver reproducible, compliant, and high\-quality machine learning solutions. * **Leadership and Organization** * Build, lead, and develop a team of approximately 25 global ML researchers and engineers; grow leaders within the group. * Own budget, vendor relationships, and external collaborations with academic groups, consortia, and biotech partners. * Represent the function to R\&D leadership, translating technical capability into portfolio impact and translating portfolio priorities into technical strategy. Contribute to the broader scientific community through publication, presentation, and precompetitive collaboration. * **WHO YOU ARE** Bayer seeks an incumbent who possesses the following: **Required Qualifications** * PhD in a relevant scientific discipline with a strong track record of applying machine learning to drug discovery. Equivalent industrial experience may substitute for formal qualifications for candidates with an MSc. * Recognized expertise in advanced machine learning methods, including foundation models, geometric deep learning, generative AI, reinforcement learning, and agentic systems. * Deep understanding of the drug discovery process and at least one major domain area, such as molecular design, disease biology, translational science, or clinical development. * Proven track record of translating advanced machine learning methods into scalable capabilities that drive measurable impact on drug discovery programs. Ability to operate as a trusted scientific partner to experts across chemistry, biology, and medicine, combining intellectual curiosity with constructive challenge. * **Preferred experience and capabilities** * Proven leadership of multidisciplinary machine learning organizations, including leading managers, developing employees, and shaping organizational strategy and culture. * Broad experience applying AI across diverse therapeutic modalities and discovery paradigms, with an understanding of their distinct scientific and operational challenges. * Broad understanding of biological systems across scales, from molecular mechanisms to patient outcomes, and how computational models can connect these levels. * Track record of influencing scientific direction both internally and externally through publications, partnerships, scientific consortia, conferences, patents, or broader thought leadership. Bayer offers a wide variety of competitive compensation and benefits programs. If you meet the requirements of this unique opportunity, and want to impact our mission Health for all, Hunger for none, we encourage you to apply now. Be part of something bigger. Be you. Be Bayer. jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, AI (Systems) Platform
jobs.description: Beacon Holdings is acquiring and operating a portfolio of vertical SaaS companies. Most private equity firms scale by adding people. We are building Beacon to scale by adding software. The thesis is simple. Portfolio operations, value creation, and deal sourcing are bottlenecked by human attention, and the right software platform can lift that ceiling by an order of magnitude. We are building that platform: an agentic operating system that our portfolio companies run on. It is a problem set with real data, real multi\-tenant requirements, and very few precedents to copy from. Beacon has raised $750M\+ from investors including General Catalyst, Lightspeed, D1 Capital, CPMG, and the family offices of the founders of Stripe, DoorDash, and Ramp. **About the Role** ------------------ Members of Technical Staff (MTS) build the platform that everything else at Beacon runs on. You will own a piece of it end\-to\-end: design, implementation, operations, and long\-term technical direction. This is a Staff Engineer role in everything but name. We run flat. We are hiring for two roles. The bar is the same; the specialty differs. * **Product and platform engineering.** A senior engineer who builds agentic products and the platform underneath them: services, APIs, data access, and deploy infrastructure. Works directly with the people who use them. * **AI infrastructure.** An engineer who builds the systems around models: serving, retrieval, evals, observability, fine\-tuning, and deployment into secure and regulated environments. Both seats ship to real businesses, fast. You take a problem from the first conversation with a user to a system in production, and measure success by whether people use it. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * You will own one or both of these areas end\-to\-end: + **Agentic products.** Build the AI\-native tools that operators across our portfolio use every day. You own the full stack: agent loops, UI, internal APIs, and the deploy infrastructure other engineers build on. The bar is not demos. It is tools people choose to open on Monday morning. + **AI infrastructure.** Serve and operate models, including open\-weight ones, across cloud, VPC, and isolated environments. Fine\-tune open\-weight models on proprietary data where a general model falls short. Build the retrieval and governed data access that ground agents in real business data. Choose which model handles which job, with cost, latency, and quality as explicit trade\-offs. * **Evals and observability.** Build the harness that tells us whether the system is working: task\-level evals from real workflows, traces and telemetry, replay, and regression suites that catch quality drops before users do. Use the same signals to speed up root\-cause analysis when things break. * How you will work: * **Ship to real businesses, fast.** Take a problem from the first user conversation to a system in production. * **Prove quality with data.** No model or prompt change ships on vibes. * **Work agent\-first.** Agents are part of how you build, not just what you build. **Who You Are** --------------- * **Deep systems engineering.** 5\+ years building and operating distributed systems that real businesses depend on: databases, data platforms, query engines, control planes, or large\-scale services. You have profiled your way to a 10x win, and you know where things break: partial failure, capacity limits, multi\-tenant isolation, schema and API evolution. You write clean code in at least one of Python, Java, Go, C\+\+, Rust, or TypeScript. * **LLMs in production, not in slides.** You have shipped LLM or agentic systems that people rely on: RAG over real enterprise data, agentic workflows, LLM\-assisted diagnosis or operations. Coding agents are part of your daily loop. You know how these systems fail: hallucinated tool calls, silent quality drift, cost blowups, evals that measure the wrong thing. * **Close to the customer.** You have been on customer calls, run escalations, and turned what you heard into a product. You measure success by adoption, not launch. * **Built from zero, run in production.** You have been a founding engineer or taken a system from 0\-to\-1 through GA. You have also carried the pager: incident command, postmortems, and the fixes that keep the same outage from happening twice. * **Comfortable with ambiguity.** The scope of the platform is still being defined. Decisions you make in week one will shape what is possible in year three. That should energize you. * **For the product and platform seat:** strong on backend services, APIs and client architecture, internal tools, and deploy infrastructure, with enough front\-end range to ship a full product. You have built products where the agent is the core of the experience, not a chat box bolted on. * **For the AI infrastructure seat:** hands\-on with model serving (vLLM, llama.cpp, or similar), retrieval and vector search, evals, fine\-tuning, and model routing. You have deployed into environments you do not fully control, such as customer VPCs or regulated and isolated regions, and you reason about GPU memory, batching, and quantization as fluently as about API design. **Preferred Skills** -------------------- * Built on or inside modern data platforms: Iceberg, lakehouse architectures, Snowflake, Databricks, or data catalogs and governance. * Performance engineering at scale: profiling, capacity planning, and measurable cost reductions. * Shipped into regulated environments: FedRAMP, government or sovereign regions, or air\-gapped deployments. * Built LLM\-assisted observability or root\-cause analysis over real production telemetry. * Operated open\-weight inference in production: batching, KV cache, quantization, speculative decoding, multi\-GPU serving. * Founding engineer, co\-founder, or first\-hire experience. * Prior Staff or Principal Engineer experience at a high\-bar engineering org. * Open\-source contributions to data infrastructure, inference, evals, or developer tooling. **Our Values at Beacon Holdings:** ---------------------------------- * Humility: We acknowledge that the path to getting to the right answer involves being wrong along the way. We have strong beliefs which are weakly held. We actively seek new ideas and believe we can learn from anyone at any time. * Honesty: We are truth seeking in our approach to business problems. Business is a repeat game and we believe that human relationships generate alpha. We understand that trust is earned over a lifetime and can be lost in an instant. * Hunger: We play to win. We hold ourselves to high standards and will not be outworked. We take pride in having a deep sense of responsibility to ourselves, each other, our partners, and our customers. We believe to whom much is given much is expected. * Horizon: We seek to build a generational software company. This will take decades. We manage our expectations and those of our partners to take advantage of the 8th wonder of the world \- compounding growth. ***How We Use AI in Our Hiring Process:*** *To ensure transparency, we want candidates to know that Beacon Software uses Artificial Intelligence and AI\-enabled tools to assist with screening, reviewing, organizing and highlighting profiles and applications that match the key requirements for each role.* ***AI does not make hiring decisions:*** *Every application is reviewed by a member of our team, and all decisions throughout the process are made by humans. We use AI to support efficiency and consistency, not to replace human judgment. We are committed to a fair, thoughtful, and equitable experience for every candidate.*

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Own the full lifecycle of an AI\-native integration platform at enterprise customers, from discovery and implementation through production support. You will work closely with customers and a small engineering team to build reliable systems for the physical economy, turning real\-world needs into improvements to the core product. ### **What You'll Do** * Scope, build, deploy, and maintain customer integrations in production. * Develop core systems for agent orchestration, runtime infrastructure, and self\-healing integrations. * Diagnose live production issues and ship fixes directly into the product. * Work with customers to uncover edge cases and turn recurring needs into product and infrastructure improvements. * Use AI coding agents alongside sound engineering judgment to build and ship software. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 3 years of software engineering experience, with a record of owning and shipping production systems end to end. * Experience with customer\-facing deployments or technical implementations, production debugging, and integration or backend development. * Proficiency in TypeScript and hands\-on experience with React, Bun, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, or AWS; familiarity with Effect\-TS is useful. * Ability to discover ambiguous customer requirements and shape them into practical technical plans. * Experience using AI coding agents while applying engineering judgment to review and deploy their work. * Enterprise systems, APIs, data transformations, EDI, logistics, or supply\-chain integration experience is beneficial. * Comfort working independently in an early\-stage, fast\-paced environment. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary is $150,000 to $250,000 annually, plus equity. Full health coverage and equipment are provided. Visa sponsorship is available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California, United States. Compensation Range: $150K \- $300K

jobs.title: Founding Engineering Lead
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Lead engineering for an AI company building applied machine learning products for enterprise software. You will shape the platform architecture and technical direction while leading a small engineering pod and continuing to build core product capabilities hands\-on. ### **What You'll Do** * Lead a pod of three to four engineers, supporting their growth, performance, and hiring while remaining hands\-on with critical work. * Own end\-to\-end platform architecture, including build\-versus\-buy choices and infrastructure decisions. * Establish engineering standards for AI\-assisted development, including code review, definition of done, release cadence, and on\-call practices. * Lead technical design and initial implementation for new initiatives. * Assess applied ML research and determine what is suitable for production systems. * Partner with technical leadership on product roadmap, model strategy, and machine learning direction. * Initially spend most of your time building, with the balance focused on leading the team. ### **What We're Looking For** * Typically 5 to 8 years of engineering experience, with exceptional candidates considered from 4 to 5 years. * Experience as a technical founder, founding engineer, staff\-level individual contributor, or engineering lead at an AI\-focused company. * Hands\-on ownership of applied machine learning products, including training and deploying models in production, beyond using LLM APIs or conducting pure research. * Experience owning architecture end\-to\-end and making build\-versus\-buy and infrastructure cost decisions. * Experience setting engineering standards and leading engineers, while remaining an active contributor to production code. * Strong judgment across classical machine learning and newer approaches, including transformers and AI agents. * Recent end\-to\-end delivery experience, comfort with ambiguity and inherited code, and a record of stable engineering tenure. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $200,000 to $400,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available. ### **Location** On\-site in New York City. Compensation Range: $200K \- $400K

jobs.title: Founding Harness Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join an early\-stage AI company building tool\-using agents for teams. You will develop the runtime, evaluations, and safeguards that help agents act usefully and reliably in real\-world workflows. ### **What You'll Do** * Design and build the agent runtime, including context gathering, decision\-making, tool selection, approval flows, and task completion. * Write and iterate system prompts to balance useful initiative with careful, appropriate behavior. * Build evaluation and regression tests for real tasks, tool use, and failure cases, and use them to catch regressions from prompt changes. * Improve reliability across long\-running work, interruptions, and retries. * Implement safety boundaries, including approval gates and multi\-tenant data separation. * Work directly with company leadership and early users to shape the product. ### **What We're Looking For** * 4 to 10\+ years of relevant experience. * Experience shipping production LLM agents that use tools, beyond demos or basic prompt wrappers. * Hands\-on experience designing and testing system prompts, plus building evaluation and regression harnesses for agent behavior. * Experience implementing safe tool execution, approval gates, and multi\-user or multi\-tenant data separation. * Strong ownership across prototyping and production, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary up to $200,000 annually, plus founding equity. Equity percentage and vesting details are to be determined. Visa sponsorship information was not provided. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, United States. Candidates should be in the Bay Area or willing to relocate. Compensation Range: $200K

jobs.title: Founding Product Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** As the founding product engineer, you will own the AI assistant and its end\-to\-end user experience. You will shape the agent's behavior and build the product surfaces and integrations that help users manage everyday tasks and communications. ### **What You'll Do** * Build the agent's decision\-making layer, including tool\-calling loops, memory, context assembly, prompt engineering, and model routing. * Develop evaluation infrastructure with conversation replay, turn\-level judges, and regression suites to guide release decisions. * Own mobile and web product experiences, from onboarding and initial interactions through follow\-ups, group chats, approvals, and trusted\-network features. * Ship features end to end, using experimentation and feature flags to measure their impact. * Build integrations for email, calendars, bookings, payments, and browser automation, with reliable recovery and user approval flows. * Review conversation transcripts, speak with users regularly, and use feedback and data to prioritize product work. * Establish engineering practices and help grow the team while continuing to contribute code. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 4 years of software engineering experience at an AI product company, AI lab, or consumer product company shipping at scale. * Production experience building agents with tool use, memory, and long\-running conversations, plus evaluation systems trusted for release decisions. * Full\-stack experience with TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Postgres. * Experience with third\-party APIs, OAuth, or payments, and agent tools such as function calling, MCP servers, or browser automation. * A record of owning features end to end and demonstrating measurable product impact. * Strong product judgment, consumer product experience, and fluency with AI\-assisted development while verifying and owning shipped work. * Post\-training or fine\-tuning experience is a plus. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $200,000 to $300,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California. Compensation Range: $200K \- $300K

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join a software engineering team building AI systems for hospitality operations. You will own full\-stack components that help resolve guest requests, from understanding intent and retrieving relevant information to coordinating tools and generating responses. ### **What You'll Do** * Build response\-generation pipelines that classify requests, assemble context, select tools, and decide when to respond or escalate. * Develop retrieval systems that ground responses in accurate, current customer data. * Create reliable orchestration for multi\-step workflows, including recovery from third\-party API failures. * Build evaluation frameworks to assess quality against real conversations and catch regressions. * Implement observability and tracing to make complex agent workflows understandable to support teams. * Develop interfaces and controls that let support leads configure agent behavior without code. * Extend the platform to voice with real\-time transcription and tool use. * Improve speed and cost through model routing, caching, and prompt refinement. * Contribute across infrastructure, data pipelines, integrations, and APIs. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 3 years of experience building and shipping production software, with 5 or more years preferred. * Relevant formal education in software engineering or a related field, along with hands\-on software engineering experience. * Full\-stack capability across areas such as backend, frontend, infrastructure, and data pipelines, with proficiency in a backend language such as Python, Go, Rust, or Java. * Experience designing and debugging production AI or machine learning systems, including retrieval, prompt engineering, or model orchestration. * Experience evaluating retrieval systems and building multi\-step workflows, tool orchestration, or function\-calling systems. * Experience with production observability, tracing, testing, and evaluation for complex systems. * Experience integrating third\-party APIs and handling production failure modes. * Real\-time systems, voice or audio processing, end\-user configuration tools, and model cost or latency optimization are useful additional experience. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** $130,000 to $220,000 base salary annually, plus 0\.20% to 1\.20% equity. Health insurance and a 401(k) match are provided. Visa sponsorship is not available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California. Compensation Range: $130K \- $220K

jobs.title: Mid-Level AI Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join a core product team building agentic systems that automate complex, multi\-step workflows across regulated and enterprise domains. You will ship production LLM services and help ensure they are reliable, safe, and useful to customers. ### **What You'll Do** * Design, build, and maintain agentic systems for workflows across healthcare, legal, fintech, logistics, and compliance. * Own retrieval\-augmented generation pipelines and retrieval infrastructure, including vector databases, embeddings, and indexing. * Build multi\-agent orchestration, tool\-calling, memory, and reasoning components. * Develop evaluation and safety infrastructure to measure model performance, surface regressions, and support enterprise reliability. * Deliver full\-stack AI products by designing APIs and data models, building frontend and backend features, and operating production systems with CI/CD, monitoring, and testing. * Work with product and design partners to prioritize features, define success metrics, and iterate using user feedback and telemetry. ### **What We're Looking For** * Two to eight years of software engineering experience delivering shipped user\-facing or backend products. * Production experience deploying LLM\-based services, including prompt design, orchestration, and tool integration. * Full\-stack proficiency with Python and TypeScript/React or equivalent, plus experience with AWS or GCP and relational or NoSQL databases. * Working knowledge of RAG, vector databases, embeddings, and retrieval pipelines. * Experience building automated tests, evaluations, and monitoring for production AI systems. * Experience designing API\-driven, high\-throughput systems and real\-time product features. * Familiarity with agent or workflow frameworks and orchestration tools; experience with fine\-tuning or multimodal models is also useful. * Background in multi\-tenant or enterprise systems, or in regulated industries such as healthcare, fintech, or legal. * Ability to own features end to end, from data modeling through deployment and monitoring. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $150,000 to $180,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California. Compensation Range: $150K \- $180K

jobs.title: Senior Member of Technical Staff
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join a founding engineering team building AI\-powered tools for law enforcement and the broader criminal justice system. In this high\-autonomy role, you will develop and deploy secure AI systems that help investigative teams manage and analyze complex evidence. ### **What You'll Do** * Build resilient, secure distributed systems for AI\-powered evidence search and analysis. * Deploy large language models, vision models, and other machine learning systems in production. * Design retrieval\-augmented generation pipelines and semantic search for unstructured evidence. * Architect structured data systems, including query planning and semantic reasoning layers. * Develop or integrate agentic systems that reason, plan, and act across investigative data. * Keep current with AI models and infrastructure, and drive work end to end in a fast\-moving team. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 6 years of backend engineering experience building distributed systems, including 3 or more years at an established organization and 2 or more years at an early\-stage startup. * Production experience deploying LLMs, vision\-language models, or other machine learning systems. * Proficiency in multiple programming languages, including Python, with experience across infrastructure providers; React experience is relevant. * Experience designing RAG or similar pipelines for unstructured data and building structured data systems with query planning, semantic modeling, or structured reasoning. * Strong focus on security and resilience, and comfort working in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments. * Experience with agentic AI systems is a plus. * Authorization to work in the United States is required. Visa sponsorship is not available. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $150,000 to $215,000 annually. ### **Location** Hybrid in New York, United States. Compensation Range: $150K \- $215K

jobs.title: Junior Software Developer – Print & Packaging
jobs.description: **Junior Software Developer – Print \& Packaging** ================================================== **Company:** PackOS / Calyx Containers **Location:** West Valley City, Utah (On\-site) **Employment Type:** Full\-Time **Experience Level:** Entry\-Level / Junior **Compensation:** Competitive, based on experience **About PackOS** ---------------- PackOS is building the operating system for the print and packaging industry. Our mission is to connect the entire packaging production process from customer requests and artwork submission to quoting, prepress, manufacturing, quality control, and order fulfillment, through intelligent software and automation. PackOS is being developed alongside Calyx Containers, a vertically integrated packaging manufacturer with real\-world production capabilities in digital printing, labels, flexible packaging, and rigid containers. Unlike traditional software companies, we build and test our technology directly inside an operating manufacturing facility. **About the Role** ------------------ We are looking for a **Junior Software Developer with hands\-on experience in printing, packaging, or prepress** to help build the next generation of manufacturing software. This is a unique opportunity for someone who understands how a print shop or packaging operation works and wants to transition into software development. You don't need to be an experienced software engineer. We are looking for someone with a technical mindset, basic programming knowledge with AI tools like Codex/ Claude Code, Antigravity, and a genuine interest in building software that solves real manufacturing problems. You will work closely with experienced developers, production operators, and company leadership to build practical software solutions that improve how packaging is designed, quoted, manufactured, and delivered. You will also use modern AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate your work while learning professional software engineering practices. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Software Development** * Develop and improve features within the PackOS platform. * Build user interfaces, dashboards, and internal tools. * Assist with coding, debugging, testing, and maintaining applications. * Work with APIs, databases, and manufacturing system integrations. * Use AI\-assisted coding tools such as Claude Code and other modern development environments. * Review, test, and validate AI\-generated code with guidance from senior developers. **Printing \& Packaging Automation** * Help automate artwork intake, preflight checks, quoting, and production workflows. * Translate real\-world print shop operations into software requirements. * Support integration with print MIS, ERP, and manufacturing equipment. * Assist in developing tools for production tracking, machine data collection, and quality control. * Work directly with operators to understand production challenges and test software improvements. **Collaboration \& Learning** * Work alongside the software development team to build and release new features. * Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and product testing. * Learn modern web development tools and software engineering practices. * Troubleshoot issues directly on the manufacturing floor. * Document technical processes and software functionality. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- We are primarily looking for someone who combines **print or packaging industry experience with foundational software development skills**. * Hands\-on experience in commercial printing, labels, packaging manufacturing, or prepress. * Basic programming knowledge, demonstrated through coursework, personal projects, professional experience, or self\-directed learning. * Familiarity with at least one programming language, such as JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python. * Basic understanding of how software applications, databases, or APIs work. * Ability to troubleshoot technical problems and learn new systems. * Strong attention to detail and willingness to work directly with manufacturing teams. * Interest in AI, automation, and modern software development. A computer science degree is not required. Relevant industry experience, demonstrated technical ability, and a strong willingness to learn are more important. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- Experience with any of the following is a plus, but not required: **Print \& Packaging** * Digital printing, especially HP Indigo equipment * Flexographic printing and label converting * Flexible packaging production * Adobe Illustrator and print production workflows * Dielines, color separations, PDF preflight, and artwork preparation * Print MIS systems such as LabelTraxx or Radius * Manufacturing ERP systems such as NetSuite **Software \& Technology** * JavaScript / TypeScript * React and Node.js * SQL and PostgreSQL * REST APIs and system integrations * Git and GitHub * Claude Code or other AI coding assist --------------------------------------- **Learn software development inside a real factory.** You will have direct access to production equipment, manufacturing operators, and real\-world workflows while helping develop the software that supports them. **Work with modern AI technology.** Our development approach incorporates AI\-assisted programming, workflow automation, and intelligent software systems. **Build technology with immediate impact.** Rather than working on abstract projects, you will help solve actual manufacturing problems and see your software used in production. **Grow into a software engineering career.** You will work with experienced engineers and develop practical skills in full\-stack development, manufacturing technology, and AI\-driven applications. **Benefits** ------------ * Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience * Health insurance benefits * 401(k) retirement plan * Professional development and mentorship * Hands\-on exposure to advanced manufacturing and AI technology * Opportunity for career growth as PackOS expands MORE ABOUT US: Our team is composed of bright, hardworking, creative, and highly motivated individuals looking to make an impact on the world. We seek like\-minded colleagues who share our values and want to apply their experience, energy, and enthusiasm to help grow and scale a dynamic business in a rapidly expanding industry. The Calyx Containers culture fosters the personal and professional growth in a challenging and rewarding environment. We operate at a fast pace, demand high personal standards, and offer everyone the opportunity to contribute, skill\-build, and develop their talents. Benefits and Perks offered to full time employees: * Flexible Paid Time Off \-Comprehensive benefits offerings including: Medical (with company\-funded HRA), Dental, Vision, Short\- and Long\-Term Disability Insurance, Life Insurance, Headspace Care Mental Health support...all effective the first day of the month following hire. * 401(k) * Ability to make an immediate impact * Monthly team meetings and frequent social events An ideal Calyx candidate looks like: * Has experience in the cannabis and/or packaging industry * Thrives in a fast\-paced environment * Handles ambiguity with a positive attitude * Rolls up their sleeves to help their team How success is measured at Calyx: First 30 days spent getting to know the company and our team! Ability to make an immediate impact \- we’re growing quickly and want you to help cultivate that! Living our core values: \-X\-treme Ownership * \-Be Quick, But Don’t Hurry * \-Sustainability Is Multi\-Dimensional * \-We Are Square: Quality Does Not Cut Corners * \-Customer Is The Only Boss * \-Earn Success Every Day * \-The Biggest Failure Is The Failure To Ask For Help * \-Better Together: Cultivate An Inclusive Environment Calyx Containers is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe strongly in fair hiring practices and in creating a welcoming environment for all team members. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Diversity drives innovation; inclusion drives success. We believe a multitude of approaches and ideas enable us to deliver the best results for our workforce, workplace, and customers. We are committed to fostering a culture where all employees can share their passions and ideas so we can tackle the toughest challenges in our industry and pave new paths to limitless possibilities. Calyx is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment and activities. To request reasonable accommodation, please contact hr@calyxcontainers.com. (Please note that applications should not be emailed to this address). HHSphZTCc2

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description: **Let’s be unstoppable together!** Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high\-quality data set. At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives. We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work. Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana. Learn more at www.circana.com. (https://www.circana.com.) **Role Overview** The Technical Program Manager drives complex, cross\-functional technical programs from concept through delivery. You’ll partner closely with engineering, product, design, and business stakeholders to turn strategy into executable plans, manage dependencies and risks across teams, and make sure programs ship on time with high quality. You bring enough technical depth to engage credibly with engineers on architecture and trade\-offs, and enough leadership to align groups that don’t report to you. You understand how LLMs, retrieval systems, and agents behave in production, you’re fluent in evaluation\-driven development, and you use AI tools yourself to remove coordination overhead and keep teams moving fast. **Job Responsibilities** **Program planning and execution** * Define program scope, goals, milestones, and success criteria in partnership with product and engineering leads. * Build and maintain integrated roadmaps and schedules that span multiple teams and workstreams. * Drive execution day to day by tracking progress, unblocking teams, and keeping work aligned to priorities. **Technical leadership** * Understand system architecture and technical design well enough to find dependencies, integration points, and delivery risks early. * Facilitate technical trade\-off discussions (scope vs. timeline vs. quality) and help teams reach clear decisions. * Partner with engineering leads on release planning, launch readiness, and post\-launch stability. **Responsible AI and risk management** * Integrate safety, privacy, security, and compliance reviews into program timelines (e.g. data governance, prompt injection risk, PII handling, EU AI Act or internal AI policy requirements). * Maintain risk registers that cover AI\-specific risks such as hallucinations, bias, model drift, misuse, and vendor lock\-in. * Coordinate incident response for AI\-specific failures, including rollback plans for model or prompt changes. **Cross\-functional alignment and communication** * Act as the central point of coordination across engineering, product, QA, security, operations, and business teams. * Run effective program rituals such as kickoffs, status reviews, planning sessions, and retrospectives. * Communicate program status, risks, and decisions clearly to audiences ranging from individual contributors to executives. **Risk, dependency, and issue management** * Identify, track, and mitigate risks and cross\-team dependencies before they affect delivery. * Escalate issues with clear context and recommended options when decisions sit above the program level. * Manage change requests and keep scope changes visible and intentional. **Process and operational excellence** * Introduce and improve lightweight processes, tooling, and metrics that help teams deliver predictably without adding unnecessary overhead. * Capture lessons learned and apply them across programs. * Define and report on program health metrics such as delivery predictability, velocity, quality, and adoption. **Requirements** * 5\+ years in technical program management, engineering, or a related technical role, with 1\+ years on AI/ML or LLM\-based products. * Hands\-on understanding of how LLM applications are built, including prompting, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), agents and tool use, fine\-tuning, and evaluation. * Experience shipping AI systems to production, including handling non\-deterministic behavior, quality regressions, and iterative improvement. * A track record of delivering complex, multi\-team technical programs. * Solid technical grounding (e.g. software development lifecycle, system design, APIs, cloud infrastructure, or data platforms, depending on the team). * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive\-level reporting. * Daily, practical use of AI tools in your own work. **Preferred** * A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * Experience in Retail/CPG industry * Exposure to responsible AI frameworks, AI governance, or regulatory requirements. * Experience leading AI adoption or transformation programs within engineering organizations. **Circana Behaviors** Beyond technical skills, experience, and role\-specific attributes, these shared behaviors are fundamental to our culture and success. We seek individuals who consistently demonstrate and champion these behaviors in their daily work: * Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. * Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. * Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. * Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. * Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. * Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. * Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. **Location:** This position can be located in the following area(s): Chicago, IL *The below range reflects the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue\-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. The salary range for this role is $155,000 USD to $175,000 USD.* *This job is also eligible for bonus pay.* *We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.* *An offer of employment may be conditional upon successful completion of a background check in accordance with local legislation and our* *candidate privacy notice* (https://nam02\.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url\=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.circana.com%2Fcandidate\-privacy\-notice%2F\&data\=05%7C02%7CJasmine.Taylor%40circana.com%7C3108d7a5a34247751fc408dc870da8b8%7C43728c2044474b27ac2e4bdabb3c0121%7C0%7C0%7C638533739951470893%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C\&sdata\=KS4AzsLAW3VAvnXaDGxSBtlAVGuZ%2B6kqfrfh55uF3wc%3D\&reserved\=0\)*. Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.* *You can apply for this role through the Circana careers website or Intranet site for internal candidates.* *This role is subject to AI\-assisted screening. jobs.title: Director of Public Works & Utilities
jobs.description: **Nature of Work:** This is very responsible, professional and difficult administrative work directing and supervising the daily operations of all public works activities for Jefferson City government. Activities associated with the job include planning, organizing and directing the work and related activities of the streets and sanitation, utilities, and building maintenance departments. Additional activities include assisting with the coordination and preparation of the annual budget and monitoring the expenditure of funds for each activity, reacting to emergency and/or urgent situations when necessary, addressing complaints from citizens and developing, implementing and enforcing departmental policies and procedures. Job duties require a B.S. Degree in civil engineering and/or Public Administration, extensive knowledge of municipal streets and sanitation activities, building maintenance, utilities, planning and building inspections, and related public works activities, excellent organizational, interpersonal, analytical and decision\-making skills, and considerable experience supervising the activities of support staff. Job performance is evaluated by the City Manager through review of the daily organization and effectiveness of departmental operations, knowledge and expertise in public works, ability to effectively supervise and direct the activities of departmental staff, responsiveness to the needs of the citizens of Jefferson City and organizational, interpersonal and decision\-making skills. **Necessary Requirements of Work:** Possession of valid Tennessee driver’s license; graduation from an accredited four (4\) year college or university with a B.S. Degree in civil engineering, or Public Administrative supplemented with additional experience and training in public works operations; extensive experience in road construction, utilities, and building maintenance; extensive supervisory experience, including hiring, scheduling, discipline and/or dismissal of subordinate employees; excellent organizational, interpersonal, analytical and decision\-making skills; sufficient strength and agility to perform the physically demanding aspects of the job in a variety of weather conditions; or any equivalent combination of education or experience to provide the following knowledge, abilities and skills: \- Extensive knowledge of the field of civil engineering practices and methods as applied to municipal public works operations. \- Extensive knowledge of state laws, municipal ordinances and the policies and procedures established for the Public Works department. \- Extensive knowledge of public works construction and maintenance practices and principles. \- Extensive knowledge of the materials, methods and equipment generally used in the maintenance, construction and repair of streets and right of ways. \- Extensive knowledge of the types and uses of vehicles and related equipment used in maintaining streets, storm water systems, right of ways and related areas. \- Extensive knowledge of water treatment operations, wastewater systems and utility infrastructure systems and components. \- Extensive knowledge of transportation systems including construction and maintenance methods and practices, federal and state guidelines and regulations and parking operations. \- Extensive knowledge of the occupational hazards and safety precautions associated with public works operations including all applicable OSHA regulations. \- Thorough knowledge of basic arithmetic calculations utilized in the preparation of budgets and monitoring of departmental expenditures. \- Thorough knowledge of business English including acceptable grammatical form and usage. \- Thorough knowledge of established personnel policies and procedures utilized by Jefferson City government. \- Thorough knowledge of effective supervisory techniques and practices, including the selection, evaluation, motivation, discipline and/or discharge of staff. \- Thorough knowledge of the geographic area of Jefferson City, including all streets, roadways, thoroughfares, etc. \- Thorough knowledge of municipal ordinances, state and federal laws applicable to public works operations. \- Thorough knowledge of established procurement and purchasing regulations for Jefferson City government. \- Ability to develop and implement effective operational policies and procedures for each operating department. \- Ability to compile and analyze detailed information and prepare accurate and thorough technical reports. \- Ability to prepare departmental budgets and monitor the expenditure of funds to ensure the proper accounting of all jobs.title: Senior/Staff Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **ABOUT CIVILGRID** CivilGrid is the trusted civil design platform powering affordable infrastructure renewal and growth. We give utilities, civil engineers, and municipalities a single, collaborative source of truth for what's underground so teams can plan, design, and build faster, smarter, and safer. Our platform consolidates utility records, geotechnical and environmental data, paving moratoriums, and jurisdictional requirements directly from 3,000\+ utilities, agencies, and municipalities with full chain\-of\-custody documentation. Teams at PG\&E, Mark Thomas, and dozens of leading engineering firms use CivilGrid to cut research time by up to 88%, reduce project costs, prevent dig\-ins, and accelerate delivery on the projects that keep communities running. We're a venture\-backed Series A startup tackling a $4\.7T US infrastructure market that has been underserved by software for decades. Founded by industry insiders, each with 10\+ years in utilities and civil engineering, we move fast, ship work that matters, and stay close to the customers and field teams we build for. **WHY THIS ROLE** As a small team, we all wear many hats and enjoy tackling new challenges. When it comes to tech, we’re seeking experienced individuals who can efficiently identify problems and devise solutions. As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will get the chance to work on challenging problems that directly contribute to the scalability of CivilGrid’s products, and be one of the first engineers shaping CivilGrid’s ML capabilities, from turning thousands of utility records into structured data to building models that reason about what’s underground. This role reports to the Head of Strategic Initiatives. It is a hybrid role with expectations that you are working from our downtown Boston office at least 3 days per week if hired. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Explore our data and workflows to identify opportunities where ML\-based solutions can have the most impact on accuracy, speed, and cost * Design, build, and ship production ML systems that turn unstructured utility records, drawings, and documents into reliable, structured data * Build LLM/VLM\-powered pipelines (prompting, retrieval, structured outputs, tool use), and know when a smaller fine\-tuned model is the better choice * Prepare training data, and train, fine\-tune, and validate models, including labeling strategy and data quality * Ship ML pipelines that can be continuously monitored and validated, with evaluation harnesses, golden datasets, and quality metrics built in from day one * Optimize models and pipelines for latency and cost at scale * Set technical direction for ML at CivilGrid and raise the bar for how the team builds, evaluates, and ships models **WHAT YOU'LL BRING** * 6\+ years of experience building and shipping ML systems * Solid grounding in ML fundamentals: transformers, embedding spaces, supervised learning, model evaluation, and error analysis * Hands\-on experience preparing datasets and training, fine\-tuning, and evaluating models * Experience taking models from prototype to production, with monitoring, versioning, and reproducible pipelines * Start Up Ready: autonomous, moves fast, takes initiative without being asked * Strong verbal and written communication, able to articulate ideas clearly and collaborate effectively * A degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field (B.S. or M.S.) **BONUS POINTS** * Experience with computer vision on VLMs (document and drawing understanding, layout analysis, visual grounding, or fine\-tuning VLMs) is a huge plus * Experience working with messy real\-world imagery: scanned documents, OCR outputs, low\-quality rasters * Familiarity with geospatial tooling (GDAL/rasterio, coordinate reference systems) * Experience with model serving and inference optimization (e.g., vLLM, quantization, batching) on AWS * Experience extracting information from technical or engineering documents **HOW WE WORK** We're a small, but rapidly growing team that ships. Expect direct feedback, real ownership from day one, and proximity to customers — huge utilities, public agencies, and engineering firms whose work depends on what we build. We default to in\-person collaboration where it matters and remote\-friendly flexibility otherwise. We hire people who care deeply about their craft and the communities our customers serve. **COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS** **The base salary range for this role is** *$149,405– $246,123*. Base salary is only one part of your total compensation package at CivilGrid, which also includes meaningful early\-stage equity, comprehensive benefits, and the opportunity to shape a category\-defining company. The base salary range listed above may encompass various levels and/or geographic locations; final offers are determined based on the candidate's experience, skills, level, and work location. In addition to base and equity, we offer: * Company\-funded medical, dental, and vision insurance — including medical plans at no cost to the employee * FSA (health and dependent care) * Unlimited PTO and a culture that expects you to actually use it * 401(k) plan * Flexible, remote\-friendly work environment * A high\-trust team, real ownership, and the chance to do the most meaningful work of your career **EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY** CivilGrid is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Employment decisions at CivilGrid are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please contact us — we're happy to help. Compensation Range: $149,405 \- $246,123

jobs.title: Data Center / Data Centre / DC / Datacenter
jobs.description: **Job Title: Data Center Operations Engineer** **Location: Onsite 5x per week: Richardson TX and Allen TX (about a 25\-minute drive apart) and Dallas TX as needed; travel to remote data centers as required.** **Duration: Contract 12 Months** **Shift: 3:30 PM to midnight** **Role Overview** * The Data Center Operations Engineer keeps a globally distributed SaaS data center infrastructure running around the clock. The role covers hands\-on installation, configuration, troubleshooting and lifecycle management of data center hardware, and close coordination with internal teams and third\-party vendors in a SAFe Agile environment. Performance is measured on uptime and reliability, response and resolution times, accuracy and timeliness of installations and asset records, and the quality of vendor coordination. **Responsibilities** * Daily onsite support * Onsite support for data centers in Richardson, TX and Allen TX (primary) and occasional Dallas TX. * Shift hours 3:30 PM to midnight, with potential overtime. * Occasional international travel required. Hardware installation and asset management * Install data center hardware in racks, and configure, test and troubleshoot all installed equipment. * Review cable manifests and troubleshoot rack and stack equipment. * Enter and update asset information and manage hardware inventory. Data center operations * Manage the server build process for physical and virtual servers (VMs). * Provide remote hands support for colocation facilities, and monitor colocation advisements of outages, maintenance work and shipments. * Degauss hard disk drives at end of life, and manages equipment reuse, recycling and disposal. * Configure network switch ports and order circuit cross\-connects. * Provide CCA customer Letters of Authorization (LOAs) and set up corresponding BGP routes. * Report regularly on uptime, incidents and resolutions. * Document installations, configurations and troubleshooting. * Maintain records of maintenance schedules, vendor interactions and change requests. jobs.description: **About us**Creative Information Technology Inc (CITI) is an esteemed IT enterprise renowned for its exceptional customer service and innovation. We serve both government and commercial sectors, offering a range of solutions such as Healthcare IT, Human Services, Identity Credentialing, Cloud Computing, and Big Data Analytics. With clients in the US and abroad, we hold key contract vehicles including GSA IT Schedule 70, NIH CIO\-SP3, GSA Alliant, and DHS\-Eagle II. Join us in driving growth and seizing new business opportunities. **Role and Responsibilities** VITA \- Virginia Information Technology Agency is seeking a Sr. Cybersecurity Engineer. Work schedule is Hybrid/Onsite \- Mechanicsville, VA. VITA\-ABC is looking for an Expert Cybersecurity Engineer (12\+ yrs) who can develop cyber defense solutions, perform network security analysis and preliminary incident response, and support IAM, vulnerability, patch, and monitoring operations and strategic initiatives. The Cybersecurity Engineer will work as a senior member of Virginia ABC’s In formation Security Operations team, splitting time between day\-to\-day security operations and longer\-term security improvement work. A typical day starts with reviewing security alerts and events from overnight in the SIEM and endpoint security tools. The engineer triages anything that needs attention, investigates suspicious activity, and conducts preliminary incident response when needed, including gathering evidence, recommending containment, and escalating according to established procedures. They review threat intelligence and security advisories to find new threats relevant to the agency’s environment. Through the rest of the day, the engineer works on reducing the team’s operational backlog. This includes analyzing vulnerability scan results, prioritizing findings by risk and exploitability, coordinating remediation with system owners, and verifying that fixes are complete. They support patch and configuration management by reviewing compliance, helping resolve failed deployments, and working through exceptions for systems that can’t be patched right away. On the identity side, they review access and privileged account activity and support access governance tasks. The engineer also contributes to strategic security initiatives. This includes designing and implementing security controls and improvements, tuning and building detection rules, improving log coverage, and helping mature security processes. They perform in\-depth network and system security analysis to find weaknesses and recommend fixes. All work follows the agency’s change management process. The engineer writes and maintains technical documentation, including procedures, runbooks, and configuration standards, and works with IT infrastructure, endpoint, and application teams to put security changes in place. They work independently, manage several priorities at once, provide guidance to team members, and report progress to the Assistant Director of Information Security Operations. Virginia ABC's Information Security Operations team is seeking an expert\-level Cybersecurity Engineer to strengthen the agency's cyber defense posture. The engineer will design, implement, and support security solutions across the enterprise, perform in\-depth security analysis, and help the team carry out operational security work and strategic initiatives. The position calls for a highly skilled professional who can work independently in a complex, highly secure government environment and contribute across multiple security disciplines. * Design, implement, and maintain advanced cyber defense solutions and security changes across the enterprise infrastructure, making sure systems are built to specification and deployed successfully. * Safeguard the enterprise infrastructure against unauthorized intrusion and data exfiltration. * Design, maintain, and operate security controls within highly complex, highly secure network and communications environments. * Perform in\-depth network and system security analysis to find vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and threats to the organization's security posture. * Monitor, review, and analyze security events and alerts, and conduct preliminary incident response, event analysis, and threat intelligence activities. * Support vulnerability management activities, including assessment, risk prioritization, remediation coordination, and validation. * Support patch and configuration management processes to keep enterprise endpoints and servers secure and compliant. * Support identity and access management security controls, including access governance, privileged access, and authentication practices. * Help improve security monitoring, detection capabilities, logging, and alerting. * Develop and maintain technical documentation, including procedures, runbooks, and security configurations, in line with change management and audit requirements. * Work with cross\-functional IT teams and stakeholders to put security improvements in place and reduce operational risk. **Required Qualifications*** 12\+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity engineering, security operations, or a closely related field. * Demonstrated experience designing and operating security controls in complex, high\-security enterprise network environments. * 8\+ years of experience in network security analysis and security event review. * 8\+ years of experience in incident response, event analysis, and threat intelligence. * 6\+ years of experience in vulnerability management, including assessment, prioritization, and remediation. * Strong knowledge of network security, threat analysis, incident response, and vulnerability management principles. * Experience analyzing security events and producing actionable findings. * 6\+ years of experience producing clear technical documentation in a change\-controlled environment. * Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical audiences. **Preferred Qualifications*** 5\+ years of experience in identity and access management security controls. * 5\+ years of experience in Microsoft\-centric enterprise environments, including Entra ID, Intune, Configuration Manager, and Microsoft 365\. * 5\+ years of experience with enterprise vulnerability scanning, SIEM, and endpoint security platforms. * Familiarity with security frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, NIST 800\-53, or CIS Controls. * 5\+ years of experience supporting state or local government agencies. * Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GIAC (GCIH, GCIA, GSEC), CySA\+, or Security\+.

jobs.title: Quality Specialist, Full-time
jobs.description: D. La Porte N.A., the North American subsidiary of D. La Porte \& Söhne GmbH, is a global manufacturer of cabin door systems for the agriculture, construction, and specialty equipment markets. We are seeking a motivated, detail\-oriented **Quality Specialist** to support our manufacturing quality operations and develop into a leadership role within the company. This position combines hands\-on inspection and manufacturing activities with technical analysis, problem\-solving, quality documentation, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate has strong mechanical aptitude, excellent organizational skills, demonstrated initiative, and an interest in taking ownership of increasingly complex responsibilities. Working closely with our Product Quality Engineer, the successful candidate will progressively assume responsibility for quality systems, inspection processes, supplier and customer quality concerns, and corrective actions. **Our long\-term objective is to develop an individual capable of independently managing the company's day\-to\-day quality function**, with continued technical support from Engineering. As a small manufacturing company, we value dependable, adaptable employees who work independently and willingly contribute across multiple areas of the business. While quality is the primary responsibility, this position also provides backup support for shipping and receiving and may assist with product assembly when operational needs require. The position involves direct communication with customers, suppliers, and international colleagues, requiring professionalism, sound judgment, and strong written and verbal communication skills. With more than 160 years of history, D. La Porte is committed to maintaining a clean, safe, professional workplace and investing in our employees and facilities. Our manufacturing environment includes natural lighting, temperature\-controlled warehouse space, modern equipment, on\-site solar energy, and complimentary electric vehicle charging. We offer competitive employee benefits, professional development opportunities, and a clear path toward increasing independence and responsibility. Our ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 certifications reflect our commitment to product quality, environmental responsibility, and continuous improvement. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** **Quality Inspection and Product Conformance** · Perform incoming, in\-process, and final inspections to verify compliance with engineering drawings, specifications, and customer requirements. · Interpret engineering drawings, dimensions, tolerances, and technical specifications using appropriate precision measuring instruments. · Maintain accurate inspection records and identify, document, and coordinate disposition of nonconforming materials and products. · Support product testing, inspection procedures, and product traceability requirements. **Quality Systems and Problem Solving** · Support the administration, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the company's ISO 9001 quality management system. · Investigate quality concerns, identify root causes, coordinate corrective actions, and verify their effectiveness. · Maintain controlled quality documentation, inspection procedures, records, and related information systems. · Participate in internal and external audits, monitor quality performance, and recommend improvements. **Supplier and Customer Quality** · Work with Purchasing, Engineering, suppliers, and customers to investigate and resolve product quality concerns. · Support supplier performance monitoring, nonconformance reporting, and corrective action follow\-up. · Communicate quality findings and corrective action progress professionally with internal departments, customers, suppliers, and international colleagues. **Operational Support and Professional Development** · Provide backup support for shipping and receiving, including material handling, order preparation, packaging, and shipment verification. · Assist with product assembly, inventory accuracy, and other manufacturing or warehouse activities as business needs require. · Progressively assume responsibility for coordinating daily quality activities, managing quality documentation, and supporting management reviews. · Develop the technical, organizational, and leadership capabilities necessary to independently manage the company's day\-to\-day quality operations, with continued engineering support. **Requirements and Qualifications** * High school diploma or GED, with previous experience in manufacturing, quality inspection, mechanical assembly, or a related technical environment. * Consistent and reliable attendance, punctuality, and a strong work ethic. * Strong attention to detail and ability to accurately follow documented procedures, work instructions, and inspection requirements. * Demonstrated mechanical aptitude, basic mathematical skills, and ability to understand drawings, dimensions, measurements, and how mechanical components function. * **Demonstrated proficiency with Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications**, including creating and maintaining spreadsheets, organizing data, preparing documents, and communicating electronically. * Ability to learn and effectively use ERP systems, electronic quality records, and customer information systems. * **Strong written and verbal communication skills, including professional interaction with coworkers, customers, and suppliers.** * Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, remain productive, and complete assignments without continuous supervision. * Ability to take ownership of responsibilities, investigate problems, verify information, maintain accurate records, and follow issues through resolution. * Willingness to communicate mistakes promptly and honestly, nonconformances, and quality concerns, accept feedback, and take appropriate corrective action. * Strong organizational, analytical, and problem\-solving abilities, with initiative to identify issues and contribute practical solutions. * **Ability to work effectively within a small, cross\-trained team, exercise sound judgment,** and appropriately handle confidential company, customer, and supplier information. * Willingness to learn multiple functions and assist with shipping and receiving, product assembly, warehouse operations, and other activities as business needs require. * Ability to safely use hand tools, inspection equipment, and fixtures, lift up to 50 pounds, and perform the essential physical functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation. **Desired Knowledge and Skills** * Associate degree in engineering technology, manufacturing, quality, industrial technology, business analytics, or a related field; equivalent technical or manufacturing experience will also be considered. * Two or more years of manufacturing quality or inspection experience, including the use of calipers, micrometers, gauges, fixtures, or other precision measuring equipment. * Ability to interpret engineering drawings, dimensional tolerances, technical specifications, and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD\&T). * Hands\-on experience with agricultural, construction, automotive, mechanical, or similar equipment and components. * Familiarity with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, quality management systems, internal audits, and continuous improvement practices. * Experience with nonconformance reporting, root\-cause analysis, corrective actions, supplier quality, or customer quality concerns. * Experience with SAP or another ERP system, technical documentation, product testing, data collection, or quality reporting. * Advanced Microsoft Excel capabilities, including formulas, PivotTables, charts, data analysis, and managing large data sets. **Final Thoughts** Most applicants skim job descriptions.
