LOIS reads, understands, and reasons across your data to surface insight, automate complexity, and give professionals the clarity and confidence to see more, know more, and do more. Fueled by a team of exceptional collaborators and innovators, Filevine’s rapid growth has earned AI awards and recognition from Deloitte and Inc. as one of the most innovative and fastest\-growing technology companies in the country.**Role Summary:** ----------------- Every engineer pays a tax on slow builds, flaky tests, manual release steps, and tooling they have to work around. That tax compounds, and it’s paid by every team, every day, and it never shows up on a roadmap. This role exists to pay it down, so that everyone building software for legal teams can ship faster. Today the largest known cost is the path from commit to production: GitLab CI for build, Octopus Deploy for release, across .NET, Python, and Svelte. That’s where you’ll start, and it isn’t where the job ends. The same mandate covers developer platform work, internal tooling, and purpose\-built solutions for one team’s specific problem. What stays fixed is the measure: how much faster we ship, and how much friction you took out. ### **What You'll Do:** * Work on the path from commit to production, end to end, across three language ecosystems. It’s the largest single cost today and the first thing you’ll take on. * Build internal tooling that engineers adopt because it’s better, not because it’s mandated. * Build the platform layer where it pays for itself: self\-service environments, paved paths, and shared infrastructure that teams should stop solving separately. Build one\-off solutions where a single team’s problem deserves a purpose\-built answer. * Expand our delivery metrics and use them to drive decisions and report progress. * Improve local development setup and onboarding, and bring AI\-assisted development into our workflow deliberately. ### **What You'll Need:** * Deep hands\-on CI/CD ownership: you’ve designed and rebuilt pipelines, not just consumed them. * Real software engineering ability. This isn’t a configuration role; you’ll write code your peers respect. * Product sense for internal tools, and the ability to change how engineers work without the authority to make them. You treat engineers as users, you know the difference between what they ask for and what they need, and you earn adoption through better tools, clear writing, and credibility from having shipped. * Range across more than one language ecosystem at once: several dependency caches, several test runners, one coherent release process. We care that you’ve handled the variety, not that you’ve handled ours. * Fluency in how software delivery is measured: You know the metrics well enough to instrument them, read them honestly, and use them to choose what to work on. We make decisions on data, not whim. * Infrastructure\-as\-code and containerization in practice. ### **Nice To Have** * GitLab CI at scale (runner fleets, caching strategies, reusable templates) or Octopus Deploy. * Build systems for .NET/MSBuild, Python packaging, or modern JavaScript build tooling. * Experience with monorepo tooling, pipeline observability, or security/compliance automation. * Prior background working as a product/feature software engineer *Compensation Information: $160k \- $190k* *The base salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position. The total compensation package for this position will be determined by each individual’s location, qualifications, education, work experience, skills and performance. We believe in the importance of pay equity \- the range listed is just one component of Filevine’s total compensation package for employees. This position is also eligible for a paid time off policy, as well as a comprehensive benefits package.* **Cool Company Benefits:** * A dynamic, rapidly growing company, focused on helping organizations thrive * Medical, Dental, \& Vision Insurance (for full\-time employees) * Competitive \& Fair Pay * Maternity \& paternity leave (for full\-time employees) * Short \& long\-term disability * Opportunity to learn from a dedicated leadership team * Top\-of\-the\-line company swag **Privacy Policy Notice** Filevine will handle your personal information according to what’s outlined in our Privacy Policy. jobs.title: BIM Liaison
jobs.description: Gallo Mechanical is looking for a BIM Liaison to own and run our BIM delivery process from estimating turnover through fabrication and field install. This person is the hub the whole workflow turns on: they lead every recurring project meeting, keep a large cross\-functional group aligned and moving, and make sure the model, the schedule, and the paperwork all advance together without anything slipping. This is a role for someone who is energized by structure and accountability. If you are the person who naturally keeps the room on track, remembers what was decided last week, and follows up until things are actually closed out, this is built for you. **What You'll Own** * Run the meetings — Lead the BIM Turnover, Fab Kickoff, Weekly BIM, and Recurring Fab meetings: set each agenda, keep the discussion focused, and drive it to clear decisions. Attend the Estimating Turnover meeting and capture notes to carry the project into BIM. * Keep the group aligned — Hold the attention and focus of a large, mixed group (project teams, QC, fabrication, purchasing, and leadership) as discussion moves across many topics, and make sure every participant leaves knowing what they own. * Capture and drive action items — Record action items and assignees in each meeting, review the prior week's items, and chase every open item to completion. * Manage the process end to end — Shepherd the workflow through its phases and the model through its revisions (Rev A to Rev 0 to released for fab), making sure each stage's prerequisites are met before the next begins. * Own the tracking system — Set up and maintain the project's Monday.com boards (or equivalent), keeping schedules, submittal statuses, and open items current and visible to everyone. * Coordinate the handoffs — Keep the BIM schedule, fab schedule, material matrix, submittals, and welding/QC documentation moving between the right people at the right time, and surface conflicts before they become delays. **Requirements** * Exceptional organization — You track many parallel threads at once and nothing falls through the cracks. * Strong meeting facilitation — You can run a room, keep a large group focused, move a packed agenda along, and close out decisions rather than letting them drift. * Clear, proactive communication — You follow up, confirm ownership, and keep everyone informed without being asked. * Comfort with construction and BIM workflows — Familiarity with mechanical construction, Building Information Modeling, model revisions, submittals, and fabrication coordination. * Systems fluency — Hands\-on with project/task tools such as Monday.com, Procore, and modeling/coordination software; quick to learn new platforms. * Follow\-through — You own outcomes, not just updates, and you hold others to their commitments professionally. **Preferred** * Experience in a BIM coordinator, project engineer, or construction project coordination role. * Familiarity with Revit, Navisworks, or similar coordination tools. * Understanding of fabrication and spooling workflows and field install sequencing. **Benefits** At Gallo Mechanical LLC, our foundation is built on the core values of family, service, and exceptional performance. Our lab mirrors a research and development department \- cutting\-edge strategies are born, tested and tested again. Along with a team of great minds, you take on complex topics like how we use power or how to run state\-of\-the\-art, environmentally\-friendly facilities. experience in a JVM\-based codebase. * A track record of designing and owning distributed systems from start to finish. * Experience with Rust, or a well\-formed view of when it’s the right tool, and workflows, AutoML, and MLflow for model deployment and management. * Experience with binary analysis libraries (LIEF, ssdeep, TLSH) and security tooling integration. **Benefits:** Halcyon offers the jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Inference Infrastructure
jobs.description: **Who We Are** ============== **Join us in putting the world’s compute behind the people building what comes next.** At Hyperbolic, we’re making global AI compute liquid. We bring fragmented, heterogeneous GPU capacity together into one unified, productive platform, making it easier to access, sell, resell, manage, and orchestrate the resources that power AI. For neocloud, we turn GPU capacity into productive infrastructure that delivers lasting value and accelerate their time to market. We believe bold ideas deserve the computing power to become reality. We’re building toward a future where compute flows as freely as electricity, available when and where it’s needed, so builders everywhere can turn their most ambitious ideas into breakthroughs. We’re looking for curious, driven people who take ownership, challenge assumptions, and care deeply about what they build. If you’re energized by hard problems and want to help shape how the world accesses AI, we’d love to build with you. **About the Role** ================== We're looking for a **Member of Technical Staff – Inference Infrastructure** to build and scale the systems that make large\-scale inference reliable, efficient, and easy to operate. You'll own the infrastructure and automation behind model deployment and serving, from packaging and startup orchestration to autoscaling, observability, and production reliability. Working closely with our inference and platform teams, you'll build the systems that allow models to be deployed, scaled, monitored, and recovered seamlessly across distributed GPU infrastructure. This is a hands\-on engineering role with significant ownership over production systems. You'll solve complex challenges in distributed systems, GPU orchestration, and serving infrastructure, helping build a platform where inference engineers can focus on model performance while the underlying infrastructure scales reliably with customer demand. **What You Will Do** ==================== * **Build and automate model deployment.** Design and improve systems for model packaging, deployment, and lifecycle management, including warm and cold starts, rollout strategies, and recovery. * **Scale inference infrastructure.** Develop and operate autoscaling and orchestration systems that dynamically manage GPU serving capacity based on workload demand, performance requirements, and resource availability. * **Optimize distributed serving orchestration.** Build infrastructure that supports efficient workload placement, scheduling, and dynamic prefill/decode disaggregation and rebalancing across GPU clusters. * **Own production reliability.** Establish and improve monitoring, alerting, incident response, and operational practices that keep inference services reliable, observable, and resilient. * **Improve deployment safety and automation.** Develop tooling and processes for safe deployments, automated recovery, infrastructure maintenance, and continuous improvements to serving availability. * **Partner across infrastructure and inference.** Work closely with platform engineers to integrate inference services with shared GPU infrastructure, Kubernetes, networking, and storage, while defining clear interfaces across teams. * **Drive operational excellence.** Identify recurring infrastructure bottlenecks, investigate production incidents, and build scalable solutions that reduce manual intervention and operational complexity. * **Build for long\-term scale.** Help shape the architecture and evolution of Hyperbolic's serving infrastructure as we expand across heterogeneous hardware, distributed clusters, and growing customer workloads. **Who You Are** =============== * **You've operated production LLM inference systems.** You have hands\-on experience deploying, scaling, and maintaining LLM serving infrastructure in production, with meaningful ownership of reliability and operational outcomes. * **You have strong distributed systems fundamentals.** You understand how to design, debug, and operate complex systems involving orchestration, networking, resource management, and service reliability. * **You're experienced with Kubernetes and GPU infrastructure.** You've worked with container orchestration, GPU workloads, and the challenges of managing compute resources across production clusters. * **You know how to build for scale.** You have practical experience implementing autoscaling, workload scheduling, or serving\-platform automation to respond to changing demand and resource availability. * **You take production reliability seriously.** You've owned monitoring, observability, incident response, and on\-call responsibilities, and know how to build systems that recover gracefully when things go wrong. * **You have strong software engineering skills.** You're comfortable designing, implementing, and maintaining production services and infrastructure automation, rather than relying solely on manual operations or configuration. * **You take ownership from design through operations.** You can explain systems you've personally built, the tradeoffs behind your decisions, and how you've handled failures, scaling challenges, and evolving requirements. * **You're curious, proactive, and collaborative.** You enjoy solving difficult infrastructure problems, identifying opportunities to improve reliability and efficiency, and working across teams to deliver practical solutions. **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ Experience with any of the following would be valuable, but none is individually required: * Experience operating LLM inference frameworks jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Inference Optimization
jobs.description: **Who We Are** ============== **Join us in putting the world’s compute behind the people building what comes next.** At Hyperbolic, we’re making global AI compute liquid. We bring fragmented, heterogeneous GPU capacity together into one unified, productive platform, making it easier to access, sell, resell, manage, and orchestrate the resources that power AI. For neocloud, we turn GPU capacity into productive infrastructure that delivers lasting value and accelerate their time to market. We believe bold ideas deserve the computing power to become reality. We’re building toward a future where compute flows as freely as electricity, available when and where it’s needed, so builders everywhere can turn their most ambitious ideas into breakthroughs. We’re looking for curious, driven people who take ownership, challenge assumptions, and care deeply about what they build. If you’re energized by hard problems and want to help shape how the world accesses AI, we’d love to build with you. **About the Role** ================== We're looking for a **Member of Technical Staff – Inference Optimization** to push the boundaries of inference performance through low\-level systems and GPU optimization. You'll work on the kernels and execution paths that determine how efficiently AI models run, improving throughput, latency, and GPU utilization across diverse hardware and workloads. Working closely with our inference team, you'll investigate performance bottlenecks, develop and implement optimizations, and help shape how we make inference faster and more cost\-efficient at scale. This is a hands\-on engineering role with meaningful technical ownership. Depending on your experience, you'll have the opportunity to lead focused optimization projects, tackle complex systems challenges, and influence the broader technical direction of inference performance at Hyperbolic. **What You Will Do** ==================== * **Profile and diagnose performance bottlenecks.** Analyze inference workloads to identify inefficiencies in GPU execution, memory movement, compute utilization, and model execution. * **Develop high\-performance GPU optimizations.** Design, implement, and optimize GPU kernels and low\-level execution paths to improve inference speed, efficiency, and hardware utilization. * **Benchmark and validate improvements.** Measure throughput, latency, and resource efficiency across representative workloads, ensuring performance gains are reproducible and meaningful. * **Balance performance and correctness.** Evaluate numerical precision, model accuracy, and implementation complexity when developing and validating optimizations. * **Drive high\-impact technical improvements.** Collaborate with the inference team to identify and prioritize optimization opportunities based on performance data, engineering effort, and expected impact. * **Bring optimizations into production.** Work closely with inference infrastructure and platform engineers to integrate, test, and deploy performance improvements into production serving systems. * **Share technical insights.** Communicate findings, tradeoffs, and engineering decisions clearly through benchmarks, documentation, code reviews, and technical discussions. **Who You Are** =============== * **You have strong GPU programming fundamentals.** You understand GPU architecture, memory hierarchies, parallel execution, and the relationship between low\-level kernels and model performance. * **You're experienced with performance optimization.** You've worked on inference optimization or related training and systems performance problems, with hands\-on experience identifying bottlenecks and implementing improvements. * **You're comfortable working close to the hardware.** You have practical experience with tools and languages such as CUDA, Triton, C/C\+\+, or PyTorch, and understand how to use them to investigate and improve performance. * **You approach problems analytically.** You can profile a workload, identify the underlying cause of a performance issue, develop a hypothesis, and validate your solution through rigorous benchmarking. * **You balance speed with correctness.** You understand the importance of numerical accuracy, reproducibility, and maintainability when making performance improvements. * **You take ownership of your work.** You can explain your technical contributions, the decisions behind them, and the measurable impact of your optimizations. * **You're intellectually curious and proactive.** You enjoy digging into difficult technical problems, questioning assumptions, experimenting with new approaches, and independently pursuing opportunities to improve performance. * **You collaborate effectively.** You communicate technical findings clearly, welcome feedback, and enjoy working with engineers across different areas of the stack to bring improvements into production. **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ *Experience with any of the following would be valuable, but none is individually required:* * A master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. Equivalent hands\-on experience and demonstrated technical depth are equally valued. * Experience optimizing LLM inference workloads, transformer architectures, or other compute\-intensive machine learning models. * Experience with GPU kernel development using CUDA, Triton, or related low\-level programming frameworks. * Familiarity with inference serving frameworks such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT\-LLM, or similar systems. * Experience with model optimization techniques such as quantization, kernel fusion, attention optimization, or memory\-efficient execution. * Familiarity with GPU profiling and performance analysis tools, such as NVIDIA Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute, or PyTorch Profiler. * Experience optimizing workloads across different GPU architectures or hardware configurations. * Contributions to open\-source GPU kernels, inference frameworks, or machine learning performance projects. **What Success Looks Like** =========================== Your work produces measurable improvements in inference performance and efficiency. You can identify the underlying bottlenecks, demonstrate where your optimizations deliver meaningful gains across workloads, and clearly explain the tradeoffs involved. Beyond individual performance improvements, you help build a stronger optimization foundation for Hyperbolic, enabling our inference platform to serve more workloads, use GPU resources more efficiently, and deliver better performance for customers. *Hyperbolic is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.* Compensation Range: $230K \- $350K

jobs.description: **Requisition ID:** 183314 **Job Level:** Mid Level **Home District/Group:** Kiewit Nuclear Solutions **Department:** Design Engineering **Market:** Nuclear **Employment Type:** Full Time **Position Overview** --------------------- As a **Mechanical Design Engineer** with Kiewit Nuclear Solutions, you will help lead one of the most important energy shifts of our time. Nuclear power is back, and North America is counting on it to deliver clean, reliable energy for generations. You’ll be one of the engineers making that happen. This isn’t a role where your work sits on a shelf. From our engineering office, you’ll own critical mechanical systems from the first concept sketch through procurement, fabrication, construction and commissioning, and you’ll see your designs become a working plant. As part of Kiewit’s fully integrated engineering and construction organization, you’ll partner closely with our construction teams and occasionally visit sites to support the field when it counts. That gives you a level of project ownership most design engineers never get. Your expertise will matter here. You’ll solve complex problems, mentor the next wave of nuclear engineers and help shape the success of your projects, your team and our company. You’ll do it with the backing of a company that has been building for well over a century and where safety, quality and innovation are not just values, they’re our legacy. Join us and help shape the future of nuclear power. **District Overview** --------------------- Kiewit Nuclear Solutions is a full\-service engineering, project management and construction provider operating across North America. Our experience spans all aspects of the nuclear market from carbon\-free, small modular reactors to Department of Energy science, environmental and nuclear security mission capabilities. With these broad capabilities, we operate in the power utility, renewable energy, industrial and infrastructure markets. **Location** ------------ This is an office\-based position. The primary job locations include Lenexa, KS; Houston, TX; Knoxville, TN. Other locations may be considered. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Carry out integrated engineering processes to meet project goals, deadlines, and strict quality assurance standards. * Create and assess concept drawings for equipment using multidisciplinary input. * Identify, define, and resolve issues within assigned scope. * Establish mechanical design requirements based on applicable design criteria, service conditions, load combinations, codes, standards, and regulatory requirements. * Author, prepare, and review engineering deliverables, including calculations, analyses, technical evaluations, specifications, data sheets, drawings, and sketches, in line with engineering standards. * Perform and review engineering analyses and evaluations of nuclear mechanical systems, equipment, and components, including equipment sizing and component evaluations. * Support mechanical equipment selection, specification, procurement, vendor document review, fabrication, installation, testing, and commissioning. * Support design changes and resolution of field conditions, including construction and plant walkdowns as required. \#LI\-AM1 **Qualifications** ------------------ **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline from an accredited four\-year university. **Experience:** 5 to 15 years, preferably in the nuclear industry, power generation, DOE facilities, or other highly regulated industries. **Licensure:** FE/EIT and/or PE license preferred. **Technical Expertise:** * Working knowledge of nuclear quality assurance requirements (e.g., NQA\-1\). * Experience working to strict regulatory requirements (e.g., DOE, NUREGs, Regulatory Guides, Technical Bulletins). * Experience applying the ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code and other piping codes and standards in engineering analysis. * Working knowledge of ASME B31\.1/B31\.3 codes and standards and their application to balance of plant design. * Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, procedures, codes and standards, and regulatory requirements. * Perform and review engineering analyses and evaluations of mechanical systems, equipment, and components. * Familiarity with creating PFDs, P\&IDs, and general arrangement drawings for equipment packages. **Professional Skills:** * Strong attention to detail, communication, organization, analytical thinking, and problem\-solving skills. * Strong analytical mindset and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to lead root cause investigations, interpret lessons learned, and define corrective actions. * Experience providing technical guidance, checking or verification, and mentoring to less experienced individuals. * Ability to define engineering scope, establish priorities, estimate engineering effort, and execute work to project quality, cost, and schedule requirements. * Ability to represent the engineering organization professionally in technical discussions with clients, vendors, regulators, and other stakeholders. **Working Conditions** ---------------------- Travel occasionally (less than 20%) to jobsites, fabrication facilities, and/or alternate office locations as required. Other Requirements: * Regular, reliable attendance * Work productively and meet deadlines timely * Communicate and interact effectively and professionally with supervisors, employees, and others individually or in a team environment. * Perform work safely and effectively. Understand and follow oral and written instructions, including warning signs, equipment use, and other policies. * Work during normal operating hours to organize and complete work within given deadlines. Work overtime and weekends as required. * May work at various different locations and conditions may vary. We offer our fulltime staff employees a comprehensive benefits package that’s among the best in our industry, including top\-tier medical, dental and vision plans covering eligible employees and dependents, voluntary wellness and employee assistance programs, life insurance, disability, retirement plans with matching, and generous paid time off. Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Senior Vice President, Regulatory Affairs
jobs.description: ### **Description** Kriya is a biopharmaceutical company whose mission is to develop life\-changing gene therapies for diseases affecting millions of patients around the world. We leverage our proprietary computational engine, in\-house manufacturing infrastructure, and integrated design platform to engineer technologies and therapeutics with the potential to transform the treatment of a broad universe of diseases of high unmet need, with a focus on metabolic disorders, neurology, and ophthalmology. We are proud to have been named **Triangle Business Journal’s Life Sciences 2024 “Best Private Company to Work For,”** recognized by Forbes as one of **“America’s Best Startup Employers of 2024,” and honored as one of BioSpace’s “2025 Best Places to Work.”** ### **Role Overview** The Senior Vice President, Regulatory Affairs serves as the Executive Global Regulatory Head, setting and leading the global regulatory strategy for Kriya's gene therapy portfolio, from early development through BLA/MAA approval in all major markets and lifecycle management. This role owns regulatory decision\-making across the company, serves as the senior regulatory voice to executive leadership and leads direct engagement with FDA, EMA, and other Health Authorities. Working with the Product Team, the SVP establishes integrated, scientifically sound regulatory direction across the portfolio that is globally aligned with Kriya's development and business objectives. The SVP shapes early\- and late\-stage development plans, including clinical development strategy, evidence\-generation requirements, and regulatory milestones, to enable a successful transition into pivotal development. The SVP also advises the Executive Team on how to anticipate and navigate complex regulatory challenges. The SVP leads and develops the Regulatory Affairs organization. The SVP is expected to anticipate and respond quickly to changes in regulatory guidance, policy, and agency expectations, translating them into clear, timely adjustments to program strategy, submissions, and timelines so that Kriya advances its programs with speed and compliance. **Key Responsibilities** * Defines and executes integrated global regulatory strategy for all Kriya programs, from target and candidate selection through IND/CTA, clinical development, BLA/MAA, approval, and post\-approval lifecycle management. * Monitors, interprets, and responds to evolving regulatory guidance, legislation, and agency policy (e.g., FDA CBER/OTP, EMA, ICH, and other global authorities) and rapidly translates changes into actionable strategy, risk assessments, and program\-level adjustments. * Builds and maintains a regulatory intelligence and horizon\-scanning function, including oversight of tools to anticipate guidance changes, precedent decisions, and competitor regulatory activity. * Continuously explores and applies artificial intelligence and other emerging digital capabilities where appropriate to enhance regulatory intelligence, synthesize complex scientific and regulatory content, evaluate strategic scenarios, and improve the speed and quality of regulatory decision\-making. * Adapts regulatory plans, submission content, and timelines in real time as guidance, agency feedback, or program data evolve, and communicates trade\-offs and recommendations clearly to executive leadership. * Leads senior\-level engagement with FDA, EMA, and other Health Authorities, including pre\-IND, Type B/C, INTERACT, scientific advice, and BLA/MAA meetings, and expedited programs (e.g., RMAT, Fast Track, PRIME, Orphan Drug, etc.). * Partners on clinical development strategy, risk/benefit positioning, and Health Authority interactions. * Provides regulatory oversight of CMC, nonclinical, clinical, quality, and commercial readiness activities to ensure program plans meet current and anticipated agency expectations. * Leads, develops, and mentors the Regulatory Affairs team, setting clear goals, building succession depth, and fostering a culture of accountability, flexibility, and continuous learning. * Oversees preparation, quality review, and timely delivery of complex regulatory submissions (e.g., IND/CTA, Orphan Drug, Annual Reports, MAA/BLA, meeting packages) across multiple global jurisdictions simultaneously. * Ensures high\-quality, on\-time responses to agency information requests and provides regulatory leadership during inspections and internal and external audits. * Makes evidence\-based go / no go / accelerate recommendations for programs and identifies inflection points, alternative pathways, and additional opportunities for each asset. * Establishes and continuously improves regulatory processes, standard operating procedures, publishing and submission management systems, and compliance with GxP requirements. * Manages the Regulatory Affairs budget, headcount plan, and external partners including regulatory consultants, CROs, and other vendors. * Engages the external scientific, medical, and regulat s, KOLs, and industry and patient advocacy groups, to inform strategy and advance Kriya's portfolio. * Supports business development and corporate transactions through regulatory due diligence and strategic assessment. * Performs other duties as required by the needs of the company and the Regulatory Affairs team. ### **Experience \& Skills and Work Environment** **Experience \& Skills*** M.D., Ph.D., Pharm.D., or equivalent advanced degree in a relevant scientific or medical field required. * 15\+ years of progressive regulatory affairs experience in biotechnology or pharmaceutical development, including 8\+ years in senior leadership roles managing regulatory teams. * Proven track record for successfully leading regulatory strategies through to successful regulatory IND/CTA and BLA/MAA submissions required; experience with gene therapy or other advanced therapies strongly preferred. * An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered. * Regulatory Affairs Certification (RAC) preferred. * Demonstrated expertise in global regulatory frameworks and requirements (FDA, EMA, ICH, PMDA, Health Canada, NMPA, ANVISA, TGA), with strong, established relationships with Health Authorities. * Proven agility in interpreting and acting on new or changing regulatory guidance, including the ability to pivot strategy quickly while maintaining compliance and program momentum. * Deep knowledge of GxP requirements and of cell and gene therapy development (e.g., manufacturing, nonclinical, clinical, regulatory) and product lifecycle management. * Proven track record of building, leading, and developing high\-performing teams and driving organizational excellence. * Exceptional written, oral, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to present to Health Authorities, the Board, and senior leadership and to influence across medical, scientific, quality, and manufacturing functions. * Sound judgment and decisiveness under uncertainty, with a positive, solutions\-oriented approach to challenges. * Proven ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously across different time zones. * Acts as an integrity role model by visibly and consistently speaking and acting with superior moral values. **Work Environment*** Primarily desk\-based, generally in an office or home office setting. * May involve extended periods of sitting and computer use. * Travel may be required, including domestic and international travel for Health Authority meetings, conferences, and site visits. ### **Life at Kriya** **Discover True From California to North Carolina, our teammates bring a spirit of Collaboration, Leadership, and Innovation to their work every day. We’re always looking for teammates with the drive and energy to help us grow. If you want to be a part of a company with an entrepreneurial culture, a bold vision, and a meaningful purpose, join us. **Rewards \& Benefits** * Time Off \& Work\-Life Balance: Flexible Time Off Paid Parental \& Medical Leave Paid Company Holidays * Health \& Wellness:Fertility \& Family Building Benefits Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance Employee Assistance Program (EAP) Life Insurance Short\- and Long\-Term Disability Coverage * Financial Security:Equity 401(k) with Company Match Identity Theft Protection * And More! ### **About Kriya Therapeutics** won't let me leave this section blank *Kriya is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - LinOS
jobs.description: LinOS is Lineage's most strategic software initiative, transforming warehouse operations through advanced software, data science, robotics, and automation. LinOS is an intelligent warehouse orchestration platform that uses cutting\-edge data science to coordinate warehouse workers, equipment, and automated systems, increasing throughput, reducing costs, and improving operational efficiency. The platform also integrates industry\-leading robotics and computer vision technologies to automate processes traditionally performed by humans. This is software with a direct, measurable impact on the physical world. The systems we build don't just process transactions\-they help determine how goods move, how people work, and how automated equipment operates in complex warehouse environments.**This is a REMOTE role.** The Role We're looking for an experienced Senior Backend Software Engineer to help design, build, and evolve the distributed systems that power LinOS. You'll work on challenging engineering problems at the intersection of distributed computing, real\-world operations, optimization, and industrial automation. You'll collaborate with engineers, data scientists, product managers, and operations experts to turn sophisticated algorithms and complex business requirements into reliable, scalable production software. This is a hands\-on engineering role with significant technical ownership. We're looking for someone who enjoys solving difficult problems, understands the tradeoffs behind good software design, and takes pride in building systems that work reliably in the real world. What You'll Do * Design, develop, and maintain backend services that coordinate warehouse operations, people, equipment, and automated systems. * Build reliable, scalable distributed systems using asynchronous messaging, event\-driven architectures, and service APIs. * Translate complex operational requirements and data science algorithms into robust production software. * Develop integrations with robotics, computer vision, warehouse equipment, and other enterprise systems. * Take ownership of engineering solutions from initial design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support. * Collaborate closely with other engineers, data scientists, product managers, and warehouse operations experts. * Help shape the architecture and technical direction of LinOS as the platform continues to evolve. * Mentor other engineers through technical discussions, code reviews, and sharing engineering expertise. What We're Looking For * Extensive professional software development experience, including designing, developing, and maintaining complex production software systems. * Deep understanding of software engineering principles, object\-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, and application architecture. * Strong understanding of backend application development, including service design, APIs, and data persistence. * Solid understanding of relational databases, data modeling, and SQL. * Strong commitment to software quality, maintainability, testing, and operational reliability. * Ability to work independently, take ownership of substantial technical challenges, and collaborate effectively with other engineers. * Intellectual curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to learn new technologies and unfamiliar business domains. We hire for engineering ability, not familiarity with a particular technology stack. We're interested in engineers with strong fundamentals, broad experience, a commitment to delivering real value, and a demonstrated ability to learn and solve difficult problems. Additional Experience We'd Value * Experience with logistics, warehouse management, robotics, industrial automation, or other software that controls real\-world processes. * Experience integrating machine learning, optimization algorithms, or data science models into production applications. * Experience with event\-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, or complex workflow orchestration. * Experience developing systems where reliability, throughput, and operational performance are especially important. Our Stack Our backend systems are built primarily in Java, deployed to Kubernetes, and backed by PostgreSQL. We use a distributed, service\-oriented architecture in which services communicate primarily through asynchronous message queues (currently Apache Pulsar), supplemented by REST APIs. All our services are instrumented for cross\-system observability and monitoring via DataDog. Our development workflow uses standard tools for a Java shop, Git\-based source control and Jira for project management. Experience with these technologies is valuable, but none is a prerequisite. We expect strong engineers to learn new languages, frameworks, and tools as needed. Why Join LinOS? Solve interesting, difficult problems. Warehouse orchestration combines sophisticated algorithms, distributed systems, complex operational workflows, and the unpredictable realities of the physical world. See the impact of your work. The software you build directly influences warehouse throughput, operating costs, and the capabilities of automated equipment. Shape a strategic platform. LinOS is a major investment in Lineage's future. You'll have meaningful opportunities to influence its architecture and technical evolution. Work with a multidisciplinary team. Collaborate with software engineers, data scientists, automation specialists, and operations experts to tackle challenges that require both technical depth and creative problem\-solving. Build software that matters. Lineage plays an essential role in the global food supply chain. Improving the efficiency and reliability of its operations has an impact far beyond the software itself. Help us change the cost of food world\-wide. \#LI\-Remote Why Lineage? This is an excellent position to begin your career path within Lineage! Success in this role enables greater responsibilities and promotions! A career at Lineage starts with learning about our business and how each team member plays a part each and every day to satisfy our customers' requirements. Beyond that, you'll help us grow and learn on our journey to be the very best employer in our industry. We'll ask you for your opinion and ensure we do our part to keep you developing and engaged as we grow our business. Working at Lineage is energizing and enjoyable. We value respect and care about our team members. Lineage is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and is committed to compliance with all federal, state, and local laws that prohibit workplace discrimination and unlawful harassment and retaliation. Lineage will not discriminate against any applicant on the basis of race, color, age, national origin, religion, physical or mental disability or any other protected status under federal, state and local law. Benefits Lineage provides safe, stable, reliable work environments, medical, dental, and basic life and disability insurance benefits, 401k retirement plan, paid time off, annual bonus eligibility, and a minimum of 7 holidays throughout the calendar year. jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: Matternet designs, builds, and operates autonomous drone networks that enable ultra\-fast, low\-cost, and zero\-emission package delivery. From hospitals to neighborhoods, we’re transforming how essential goods move through the world. We’re looking for an Electrical Engineer to design, prototype, and sustain the electronics that power our drone and landing station platforms. You’ll work across power distribution, communication, sensing, and RF systems, helping ensure every flight is safe, reliable, and high\-performing. This is a hands\-on onsite role that blends deep technical skill with systems thinking. You’ll collaborate closely with mechanical, software, and manufacturing teams to bring robust, production\-ready designs to life. **Responsibilities:** * Design and prototype electrical systems for UAVs, docking stations, and payload loading ports, covering power distribution, RF communication, communication buses (CAN, I2C, UART, SPI, USB), and MCU\-based control systems (autopilots, motion control, battery management, vision/perception, GPS/GNSS). * Drive PCB and system\-level design for mixed\-signal, high\-speed, and RF circuits. * Design for reliability, testability, manufacturing, and maintainability are required DFx on all electrical systems. * Perform analysis and testing of electrical components to validate performance and margin to specifications, including signal integrity, EMI/EMC, and power budgets. * Integrate electrical systems with mechanical and software components to create cohesive UAV solutions. * Define board\-to\-harness interfaces, including pinouts, current ratings, wire gauge, connector requirements, and shielding and termination rules for high\-speed lines. Review harness drawings and support harness testing. * Provide test procedures and fixture solutions to support manufacturing and maintenance tests for modules, sub\-assemblies, major assemblies, and final assemblies. * Troubleshoot and debug electrical issues during prototype development and flight testing. * Collaborate with firmware and software engineers to implement and refine control and communication algorithms. * Design for fault tolerance and fail\-safe behavior; support FMEA/safety assessments; experience with safety\-critical hardware (DO\-254, ISO 26262 or similar) a plus. * Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements (e.g., FCC, CE, aviation safety) in all electrical designs. **Requirements** * 3\+ years in electronics development for embedded or high\-reliability systems, preferably in UAV, robotics, or aerospace sectors. * Proficiency in circuit design, schematic capture, DFx, and PCB layout tools (e.g., Altium, Eagle). * Experience with embedded systems, sensors, and communication protocols (e.g., CAN, UART, I2C, SPI, Ethernet). * Familiarity with high\-speed design principles (e.g., impedance control, PCB stack\-up selection, signal integrity). * Strong hands\-on background in prototyping, testing, and debugging electrical systems. * Experience collaborating with mechanical engineers. * Experience taking products from prototype to production. * Excellent problem\-solving skills and ability to work collaboratively in a team\-oriented environment. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with UAV systems, autopilot hardware, and flight control. * Experience with switching power supplies (buck/boost converters, LDOs) and power management for battery\-based systems. * Familiarity with RF compliance and test methods. * Knowledge of software development and firmware integration. * Familiarity with regulatory requirements for drone operations. **Benefits** At Matternet, we’re advancing a new era of logistics, one where autonomous drones deliver what matters faster, cleaner, and more efficiently. We know our mission is challenging, but it's worth it, and we are committed to taking care of the people who make it possible. * **Compensation:** The expected starting range for this role is $150,000–$165,000, based on San Francisco Bay Area market data. This range reflects the target starting pay for candidates who meet the minimum qualifications for the role. Final compensation will depend on factors such as your experience, skills, level, location, and potential impact. * **Total Rewards:** In addition to base pay, our compensation packages include equity and benefits such as medical, dental, vision, life, and disability coverage, flexible spending accounts (FSA), unlimited paid time off, company holidays, and a 401(k) plan.

jobs.title: VP Data Science
jobs.description: ### **Position:** ***VP Data Science and AI*** Monogram Health is seeking a **VP Data Science and AI**. This role will lead Monogram's Data Science function and enterprise AI agenda under Chief Technology Officer sponsorship, serving as the company's senior AI voice. The VP Data Science and AI will develop data scientists and machine learning engineers, advance responsible adoption and innovation, and deliver measurable clinical, operational and economic value through rigorous science and reliable production systems. #### **Responsibilities** * Lead enterprise AI direction under CTO sponsorship. Be the trusted internal voice for executives, clinicians and employees, building understanding of AI's possibilities, limits and priorities for responsible adoption. * Lead AI product innovation with Product, Engineering and Clinical from discovery and build\-buy\-partner choices to prototypes, pilots, integration, adoption and measured value. * Drive enterprise innovation beyond the Data Science backlog with business and Operations leaders. Scale valuable AI, strengthen workforce capability and stop low\-value experiments. * Partner across technology, clinical and business teams to deliver AI outcomes, with shared accountability for results and clear ownership and decision rights. * Represent Monogram as its AI leader with customers and partners and in industry forums. Explain demonstrated value, direction and responsible practices through evidence\-backed thought leadership coordinated with the CTO, Commercial and Communications. * Lead AI best practices and a cross\-functional governance framework with Clinical, Security, Compliance, Legal, Product and Engineering. Establish shared standards, risk\-proportionate evaluation and approval processes, human oversight, monitoring, practical education and reusable patterns. Safeguard protected health information (PHI) and meet applicable HIPAA, privacy and security requirements. * Develop scientists and machine learning engineers through coaching and career growth. Challenge assumptions through rigorous model, code and design reviews. * Jointly prioritize a ranked portfolio with Product, Clinical and Operations, allocating capacity to evidence\-backed predictive and generative AI that improves treatment and workflows. * Require validation that guards against data leakage, tests calibration and performance across patient groups, and verifies generated content against sources before release. * Own the production model lifecycle through scientists and machine learning engineers: deployment, monitoring, incident response and escalation, retraining, rollback and retirement, with clear owners and release criteria. * Measure clinical, operational, and economic outcomes against agreed baselines using experimental or causal methods appropriate to the use case. Validate economic attribution with Medical Economics and Actuarial partners and make uncertainty explicit. #### **Position Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field or equivalent relevant experience; an advanced degree is preferred, not required. * Minimum of ten (10\) years in data science, machine learning, analytics or applied artificial intelligence, including at least three (3\) years in senior leadership and a record of developing scientific and engineering talent. * Healthcare production\-model delivery and stewardship with measurable impact, plus a record of leading cross\-functional AI governance and adoption from pilot to scale. * Deep expertise in AI, statistical modeling, machine learning and experimental design, with sound judgment about uncertainty, bias and the difference between prediction and causal impact. * Credible executive, customer and industry communication that explains AI evidence, limitations and responsible practices clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences. * Preferred experience includes value\-based care, responsible generative AI in healthcare, and model delivery on Microsoft Azure and Databricks. #### **Compensation** The base salary range for this role is $230,769 to $300,000 and reflects the range of experience and qualifications we may consider. Final compensation will be determined based on geographic location and job\-related factors such as experience, skills, education, certifications, and internal compensation considerations. While a larger range is posted, most offers will typically fall within a narrower band based on these factors. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for additional compensation, including bonus opportunities and a comprehensive benefits package. #### **Benefits** * **Comprehensive Benefits** \- Medical, dental, and vision insurance, employee assistance program, employer\-paid and voluntary life insurance, disability insurance, plus health and flexible spending accounts * **Financial \& Retirement Support** – Competitive compensation, 401k with employer match, and financial wellness resources * **Time Off \& Leave** – 20 PTO days, 7 paid holidays, and 1 floating day to make your own, and paid parental leave * **Wellness \& Growth** – Work life assistance resources, physical wellness perks, mental health support, employee referral program, and BenefitHub for employee discounts #### **About Monogram Health** Monogram Health is a leading multispecialty provider of in\-home, evidence\-based care for the most complex of patients who have multiple chronic conditions. Monogram health takes a comprehensive and personalized approach to a person’s health, treating not only a disease, but all of the chronic conditions that are present \- such as diabetes, hypertension, chronic kidney disease, heart failure, depression, COPD, and other metabolic disorders. Monogram Health employs a robust clinical team, leveraging specialists across multiple disciplines including nephrology, cardiology, endocrinology, pulmonology, behavioral health, and palliative care to diagnose and treat health issues; review and prescribe medication; provide guidance, education, and counselling on a patient’s healthcare options; as well as assist with daily needs such as access to food, eating healthy, transportation, financial assistance, and more. Monogram Health is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, and on holidays, to support and treat patients in their home. Monogram Health’s personalized and innovative treatment model is proven to dramatically improve patient outcomes and quality of life while reducing medical costs across the health care continuum. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Energy Project Engineer/ Senior Project Engineer, Engineering Management
jobs.description: **COMPANY OVERVIEW** **Moss** is a national privately held construction firm providing innovative solutions resulting in award\-winning projects. With regional offices across the United States, Moss focuses on construction management at\-risk, design\-build, and public\-private partnerships. The company’s diverse portfolio encompasses a wide range of sectors, including luxury high\-rise residential, landmark mixed\-use developments, hospitality, primary and higher education, justice, and solar PV and BESS renewable energy. Its employees consistently rank Moss as one of the best places to work. **POSITION SCOPE AND ORGANIZATIONAL IMPACT** Moss is a family\-owned construction company with revenues exceeding $1\.5B per year and growing. Our Energy division provides turnkey, self\-perform EPC services to premier utilities and developers in the US. With offices in Florida, Texas, and Hawaii, we are able to provide those services coast to coast. Willingness to travel to solar PV and BESS project sites for EOR meetings, design page\-turn reviews, construction kickoffs, and issue resolution, approximately once a month or as needed. * **EDUCATION AND WORK EXPERIENCE** * Bachelor's degree in engineering, technical field, or related discipline is required. * 0\-1\+ years of experience as a Project Engineer and 2\+ years as a Senior Project Engineer in the solar PV and BESS construction industry, or direct engineering management of solar PV and BESS construction projects; solar experience is a plus. * Eager to learn new engineering scopes outside of a specific focus area. * A background in solar electrical systems is a plus. * Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite: Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. * Experience with Microsoft SharePoint and Teams is a plus. * Experience with AutoCAD and Procore is a plus. * Strong communication and presentation skills, including the ability to organize and present complex technical information effectively in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. * Highly organized and able to multitask multiple projects at once. jobs.title: Sr. Network Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** ***More Than Just Care, It’s Community*** Imagine doing meaningful work in a place where people vacation. That’s life at Munson Healthcare \- northern Michigan’s largest healthcare system, with eight award\-winning community hospitals serving over half a million residents across 29 counties. If you want a career in healthcare and a lifestyle most people only dream about – with freshwater lakes, scenic trails, charming downtowns, a vibrant arts scene, and endless outdoor adventures \- you might just be *Munson Material.* To us, that means teammates who live by our values of *excellence, teamness, positivity, creativity,* and a commitment to creating *exceptional experiences* for our patients and each other. Join a team that delivers outstanding care in one of the most beautiful regions in the country. ***Invested in You*** * ***Grow:*** Tuition reimbursement, in\-person and online development, and access to our career hub to help you advance. * ***Thrive:*** Full benefits, paid holidays, generous PTO, employee discounts, and free individual retirement counseling. * ***Be Well:*** Free wellness platform for you and your family, plus personalized support for personal or family challenges. * ***Be Heard:*** Share your ideas and help shape the way we work through improvement huddles, employee surveys, and town hall meetings **Job Description** ***A Day in the Life*** * Design and deploy managed LANs, WANs, and wireless networks, including routers, switches, firewalls, UPSs, and other hardware. Monitor network performance and troubleshoot problem areas as needed. Create and maintain documentation as it relates to network configuration, network mapping, processes, and service records. Oversee installation, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of all network infrastructures. Conduct research on network products, services, protocols, and standards to remain abreast of developments in the networking industry. Oversee new and existing equipment, hardware, and software upgrades. This level is staffed by seasoned staff who have had educational background and/or experience to qualify them to perform tasks independently. This level is responsible for general operations of the department including process improvement, setting schedules, resolving conflict, etc. * This position serves as the organization’s senior technical resource for wireless networking and Radio Frequency (RF) engineering, ensuring reliable, secure, and high\-performing wireless connectivity across hospitals, ambulatory facilities, clinical environments, administrative locations, and other Munson Healthcare facilities. * The engineer provides technical leadership for wireless modernization, new construction, renovations, clinical technology deployments, and infrastructure lifecycle initiatives. The position works closely with Network Engineering, Systems Engineering, Cybersecurity, Clinical Informatics, Facilities, Construction, vendors, and application teams to ensure the wireless environment supports current and future healthcare technology requirements. Munson's environment currently includes Cisco Catalyst 9800\-series wireless controllers and a combination of Cisco Aironet 2800/3800 and Catalyst 9166 access points. Current modernization efforts are progressively introducing Wi\-Fi 6/6E capabilities across the organization. **Qualifications** ***What’s Required*** ***One of the following:*** * Bachelor’s degree (preferably IS/Business or healthcare emphasis) with 2 years relevant experience (IS/Business or healthcare) * Associate’s degree (preferably IS/Business or healthcare emphasis) with 4 years’ relevant experience (IS/Business or healthcare) * 6 years healthcare or IS/Business experience **Additional Information** ***Are you Munson Material? Apply today!*** Munson Healthcare requires all employees be vaccinated or have lab confirmed immunity for Measles, Mumps, Rubella and Varicella. MHC also requires all employees to receive a flu vaccine during the flu season in the year that they are hired and annually thereafter, or receive an approved medical or religious exemption.

jobs.description: Post\-training \- San Francisco **About the Team** The Collective Alignment (User Signals) team is a post\-training research team working at the intersection of data science, human feedback, and reinforcement learning. We develop methods for learning from real\-world user interactions to build AI systems that deliver lasting value, helping people learn, grow, and accomplish increasingly complex goals with ChatGPT. Learning from user feedback presents fundamental research challenges: signals are often noisy, biased, and difficult to interpret, and improvements in offline metrics do not always translate into better experiences for users. Our team develops scientific approaches to understanding these signals and translating them into improvements in model behavior through evaluations, reward modeling, and post\-training. **About the Role** As a Research Engineer or Research Scientist, you will investigate how AI systems can learn from human feedback and real\-world usage to better serve users over time. You will develop new approaches to extracting meaningful learning signals from complex user interactions and incorporating those signals into model training. This role requires strong deep learning research skills, scientific rigor, and curiosity about how people interact with AI. You will design controlled experiments and ablations, critically examine the relationship between offline evaluations and online model behavior, and work closely with research, product, and data science teams to understand whether improvements translate into meaningful value for users. **In this role, you will:** * Develop novel methods for learning from human feedback and user interaction signals. * Research approaches to incorporating feedback into reward modeling, reinforcement learning, and post\-training. * Design rigorous experiments and ablation studies to isolate the effects of new data, objectives, and training methods. * Develop offline evaluations and investigate their relationship with online experiments and real\-world user outcomes. * Analyze unexpected results, investigate discrepancies between evaluation metrics and user behavior, and develop hypotheses to guide further research. * Evaluate tradeoffs and regressions to improve targeted model behaviors while preserving broader capabilities. * Collaborate with research, alignment, product, and data science teams. * Implement and debug experiments across large\-scale deep learning research systems. **You might thrive in this role if you:** * Have a strong background in deep learning research through academic or industry experience. * Have demonstrated research ability through publications or substantive research contributions in deep learning or LLM post\-training. * Have experience developing new machine learning methods and evaluating them through rigorous, hypothesis\-driven experimentation. * Think critically about experimental design, measurement, and what evaluation results do and do not establish about model behavior. * Are comfortable designing ablations, investigating surprising results, and reasoning about the relationship between offline metrics and real\-world outcomes. * Have strong programming skills and experience working with complex ML codebases. * Are curious about how people interact with AI and how those interactions can inform better models. **Nice to have:** * Experience with RLHF, reinforcement learning, or modern LLM post\-training. * Research or demonstrated interest in AI alignment, human feedback, or user signals. * Experience with online experimentation, evaluation methodology, or learning from noisy and jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Scaled Manufacturing, Core Infrastructure
jobs.description: Scaled Manufacturing (SMF) builds and operates container\-based services for validating infrastructure across factory environments. SMF enables repeatable production of liquid\-cooled GPU platforms \- including GB200, GB300, VR, MI355, and MI455 \- by embedding quality, yield, throughput, and readiness controls into manufacturing. SMF delivers factory infrastructure; a Control Plane for test lifecycle management, operator workflows, quality gates, fleet health, and reporting; and a Data Plane that automates tests validation. Manufacturing Repair and Triage identifies root causes, guides recovery and uses data to reduce repeat failures. Working with Supply Chain Operations, Oracle Hardware Development, manufacturing partners, data\-center teams, NVIDIA, and AMD, SMF detects hardware, firmware, software, and configuration issues before racks ship. This improves yield, reduces rework and downstream failures, and accelerates reliable AI infrastructure deployment at hyperscale. In this role, you will lead the development and architecture of scalable, fault\-tolerant distributed systems supporting manufacturing validation and automation. You will optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability; develop telemetry, monitoring, and automated testing; and troubleshoot complex production issues. You will drive infrastructure automation, security, operational readiness, and continuous improvement while collaborating across engineering teams and mentoring peers. **Minimum Job Qualifications** * Experience bringing up, validating, or troubleshooting GPU, accelerator, or server hardware in a lab, manufacturing, or data center environment. * Strong Linux skills, including operating system installation and imaging, kernel versions and modules, device drivers, boot processes, system logs, and hardware troubleshooting. * Ability to diagnose failures across the hardware, firmware, operating system, kernel, and driver layers. * Knowledge of CPU and GPU architecture, PCIe, device enumeration, BIOS/UEFI, BMC interfaces, and power and thermal behavior. * Networking knowledge, including Linux network configuration, Smart NICs , IP addressing, DHCP/DNS, and troubleshooting network connectivity. Familiarity with high\-performance networking concepts such as RDMA or RoCE. * Experience scripting and automating validation or provisioning workflows using Python and shell. * Ability to develop dependable test workflows for large\-scale systems, analyze results across many servers, and identify recurring failures or performance outliers. * Experience documenting test plans, failure investigations, and results while working across engineering and manufacturing teams. * Strong experience in data pipelines, data modeling, analytics and measurement systems, and applied AI pipelines. **Preferred Job Qualifications** * Hands\-on experience with both NVIDIA CUDA/DCGM and AMD ROCm/RVS environments. * Experience validating multi\-GPU systems, GPU interconnects, PCIe bandwidth, and single\-node or multi\-node workloads. * Familiarity with PXE/iPXE provisioning, Redfish, PLDM, virtual media, firmware lifecycle management, and factory test infrastructure. * Experience with component traceability, manufacturing yield analysis, and corrective\-action processes. * Ability to work on site at ODM facilities during platform bring\-up and production ramps. **Key Responsibilities** **GPU Platform Validation and Provisioning** * Develop automated workflows for GPU server provisioning, configuration, firmware installation, validation, upgrades, and recovery. * Build and maintain GPU burn\-in, qualification, and factory acceptance tests. Define pass/fail criteria and document results for each approved platform configuration. * Validate GPU health, device enumeration, memory, PCIe and GPU interconnects, networking, power, cooling, and performance under sustained workloads. * Use platform\-specific diagnostics, including NVIDIA DCGM and CUDA\-based tools and AMD ROCm Validation Suite (RVS) and AMD SMI. **Failure Analysis and Manufacturing Readiness** * Investigate failures across GPUs, server hardware, BIOS/UEFI, BMC, firmware, Linux kernels, drivers, operating systems, storage, and networking. * Capture logs, test results, firmware and software versions, and component identifiers to support traceability and root cause analysis. * Work with ODM engineers and internal and external partners to verify corrective actions and prevent repeat failures. Use manufacturing yield, test throughput, failure trends, and quality metrics to improve test coverage and deployment readiness. * **Infrastructure and Networking:** * Network engineering, data\-center/site networking, VLANs, VxLAN firewalls, L3 networking, gNMI, VPNs, DHCP, switch configuration (Arista), network automation, troubleshooting, Linux, Python. * Host provisioning/configuration/Terraform, containers, monitoring/observability, Prometheus, Grafana, Linux, Python Experience with Identity Provider tools such as Keycloak and FreeIPA, * **Automation and Collaboration** * Develop reliable validation tooling that can run across large factory fleets and report system health and test outcomes. * Partner with provisioning, platform, and data center teams to ensure factory tests reflect deployment requirements. * Document test procedures, known issues, recovery steps, and production release recommendations.

You will write production code, and you will also be the person who defines scope for outside contractors, reviews what they deliver, and decides whether it is good enough to ship. **Key Responsibilities:****Computer Vision \& Machine Learning:*** Develop, train, and deploy object detection and recognition models for barcode, 2D code, and text identification on industrial asset labels. * Implement rotation\-tolerant detection using oriented bounding box or equivalent approaches; labels arrive at arbitrary orientations, skew, and standoff distances, and the pipeline must handle it without operator intervention. * Solve identifier disambiguation: asset labels routinely carry multiple codes — part numbers, model codes, lot codes, vendor identifiers — with no universal marking standard. Build the detection, classification, and confidence\-scoring logic that determines which code is the correct serial identifier, and define the fallback path when confidence is insufficient. * Integrate OCR for identifiers that are printed as human\-readable text with no machine\-readable code present. * Build and maintain the data pipeline behind the models: capture, annotation standards, augmentation, synthetic data generation, versioned datasets, and reproducible training runs. * Define and track model evaluation criteria — precision, recall, mAP, per\-class failure analysis — and drive measurable improvement release over release. **Embedded \& Systems Integration:*** Deploy inference to edge compute on production equipment; optimize for latency and throughput within the constraints of the hardware (quantization, ONNX/TensorRT, batching). * Specify and integrate machine vision hardware: industrial cameras, optics, lighting, triggering, and mounting geometry. * Interface vision output with machine control systems (PLC/HMI, serial, Modbus, Ethernet/IP) to gate machine behavior on identification results. * Design and build RESTful APIs and services that move serialization data from the machine into back\-office and ERP systems, producing the records that support certificates of destruction and audit trails. * Own reliability in the field: logging, telemetry, error handling, remote diagnostics, and update mechanisms for deployed systems. **Vendor \& Program Ownership:*** Serve as internal technical owner for external engineering vendors and offshore contractors working on vision, firmware, and robotics programs. * Write technical scopes of work, define acceptance criteria and milestone gates, and evaluate deliverables against them. * Review vendor code and architecture; identify where outsourced work is accruing technical debt and correct course. * Run technical cadence with distributed vendor teams across time zones and maintain the internal documentation that keeps knowledge in\-house. * Support adjacent automation programs, including vision\-guided robotic material handling. **Required Qualifications:*** 4\+ years developing production software in embedded, machine vision, or applied ML roles. * Strong Python; working proficiency in C or C\+\+. * Practical computer vision experience with OpenCV and modern detection architectures (YOLO family or equivalent), including training and fine\-tuning your own models rather than only consuming pre\-trained ones. * Experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow, including dataset construction, training, evaluation, and deployment. * Barcode and 2D code decoding experience (Code 128, Code 39, Data Matrix, QR) using libraries such as ZBar, ZXing, or libdmtx — including the cases where they fail. * Experience deploying models to edge or embedded compute (NVIDIA Jetson or similar). * RESTful API design and integration; JSON, authentication, error handling. * Git, code review, and CI practices. * Ability to work onsite in Miramar, FL and directly with equipment on the production floor. **Preferred Qualifications:*** OCR experience (Tesseract, PaddleOCR, TrOCR) applied to low\-quality industrial imagery. * Oriented / rotated object detection specifically (OBB heads, DOTA\-style datasets, or equivalent production experience). * Industrial camera integration — GigE Vision, USB3 Vision — and practical lens and lighting selection. * PLC/controls integration experience in a manufacturing environment. * Firmware experience on ARM/STM32 and RTOS environments. * Vision\-guided robotics: hand\-eye calibration, pick\-and\-place, 3D or depth sensing. * ERP or MES integration experience (NetSuite a plus). * Experience managing or technically overseeing external development contractors. * BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. **Pay:** $110,000\.00 \- $135,000\.00 per year. **Benefits:*** 401(k). * 401(k) 6% Match. * Dental insurance. * Health insurance. * Paid time off. * Parental leave. * Relocation assistance. **Work Location:** In person.

jobs.title: ASIC Physical Design Engineer, Senior
jobs.description: **About Positron AI** --------------------- Positron AI is building next\-generation AI inference accelerators designed from the ground up for low\-latency, high\-throughput large language model inference. Chips built for the training era keep running into two walls at inference time: memory bandwidth and chip\-to\-chip networking. We designed our architecture to break through both. In simulations, Asimov delivers several times more tokens per dollar and tokens per watt than leading GPUs, at a fraction of the power. Implementation* * Support floorplanning, macro placement, and power planning across Positron's AI accelerator designs. * Drive clock tree synthesis, place and route, and routing optimization through to timing closure on assigned blocks. * Contribute to signal integrity, IR/EM closure, ECO implementation, and metal fill to deliver signoff\-quality results. * Support tapeout signoff for physical implementation deliverables. *Methodology Development* * Contribute to methodology for power grids, power/ground tiles, and bump planning. * Assist in building congestion analysis and wire estimation approaches to support early floorplan decisions. * Support partitioning and hierarchical implementation strategies for complex, multi\-block designs, under guidance from senior/principal leads. *Tools \& Technical Execution* * Execute Innovus\-based implementation flows for assigned blocks. * Apply hands\-on expertise across Innovus, ICC2, Tempus, PrimeTime, Voltus, RedHawk, and Calibre. *Closure \& Signoff* * Drive closure across timing, power, area, congestion, DRC, LVS, EM, IR, and yield for owned blocks. *Cross\-Functional Partnership* * Partner closely with backend design services to align on implementation strategy and execution. * Participate in implementation quality reviews. *AI\-Enabled Engineering* * Apply AI\-enabled techniques for automated QoR analysis, congestion prediction, routing prediction, and floorplan optimization. **Required Qualifications** * 5–8 years of experience in physical design, spanning floorplanning through tapeout. * Experience contributing to one or more advanced\-node tapeouts. * Strong proficiency in Innovus and/or ICC2 implementation flows. * Solid working knowledge of physical implementation, including floorplanning, clock tree synthesis, timing, and power closure. * Experience supporting signoff across timing, power, and related quality metrics. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with AI accelerator design. * Senior level. models. + Accident and Dose Consequence: Radiological dose consequence from different accident scenarios for the Kaleidos demonstration and production units. + Transient Analysis: Run coupled neutronics and thermal calculations to further understanding of the reactor dynamics of the Kaleidos reactor design. * Collect requirements, provide expertise and feedback to engineers in other functional areas via clear, constructive communication. * Other nuclear design and analysis duties as assigned. **Required Qualifications \& Skills:** * Bachelor’s degree in nuclear engineering or equivalent degree from an accredited institution. * 2\-5 years of nuclear engineering industry experience (MS equivalent to 2 yrs). * Experience with radiation transport methods, including with codes such as MCNP/OpenMC/Serpent. * Proficient in at least one of the following programming languages: Python, C\+\+, C\#, FORTRAN, or another scientific computing language. * Basic knowledge of thermal hydraulic principles. * Self\-motivated with strong organizational, written, and oral communication skills. * Experience working in an engineering organization and developing high\-quality work. **Desired Qualifications \& Skills** * Experience with variance reduction techniques and associated software (Attila4MC and/or ADVANTG), is a plus. * Strong experience with OpenMC, Serpent, MCNP, software development or scripting experience. * Hands\-on experience designing hardware and/or performing tests. **Additional Requirements:** * Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as plan coverage \+ 50% for dependents. * Dental: 100% top tier plan coverage, orthodontia extra, 50% for dependents. * Voluntary life, accident, hospital, critical illness, commuter and FSA/HSA are offered as employee contributed benefits. * 8\-weeks of paid parental leave for all parents. Free snacks and drinks. * Flexible PTO policy. Remote workday allocation. * Company and team\-bonding events, happy hours and in\-person camaraderie. * Beautiful El Segundo headquarters close to the Pacific Ocean. **Total Compensation and Benefits** Radiant compensates people for impact and invests in those who continue to raise the bar.
