jobs.description: Overview GAMP is hiring a hands\-on Software Development Engineer to design, build, deploy, and maintain a warehouse management system (WMS) that supports energy storage system (ESS) assembly across two Georgia warehouses. The initial project goal is to begin a limited pilot for one ESS model within eight weeks of project kickoff. You will work directly with warehouse, assembly, and quality teams to define workflows, test the system on site, and support it after launch. Duties * **Build and integrate the WMS.** Develop web applications, REST APIs, and SQL\-backed workflows. Use Git, automated testing, and CI/CD to release changes reliably. * **Integrate barcode scanners.** Build scanning workflows for receiving, putaway, transfers, assembly, and shipping. Show what was dispatched, what was received, and what remains in transit. * **Build two\-way assembly traceability.** Link cell lots, battery module serial numbers, and finished ESS serial numbers. Maintain role\-based access, audit records, backups, recovery procedures, and technical documentation. Required Qualifications * Three or more years of hands\-on software development experience. * Experience integrating barcode scanners into a production warehouse, manufacturing, or inventory system that tracks lots or serial numbers. * Experience building web applications and REST APIs backed by relational databases. * Experience using Git, testing software, deploying releases, and troubleshooting production issues. * Ability to work directly with warehouse and quality teams and provide on\-site support in Georgia. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with Zebra or Honeywell scanners, USB or Bluetooth HID scanners, or Android handheld terminals. * Experience with multi\-warehouse transfers, manufacturing traceability, quality holds, or outbound shipping verification. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines, cloud\-hosted applications, or Linux environments. * Experience in ESS, battery, automotive, or industrial manufacturing. Tell us **what you personally built, which scanners or barcode workflows you integrated, and how you supported the system after launch**. Include your earliest available start date and availability for on\-site work in Georgia. jobs.title: Security Specialist, Infrastructure - Global Security Organization
jobs.description: Security Security Specialist, Infrastructure \- Global Security Organization **Location :** New York **Employment Type :** Regular **Job Code :** A180299A Responsibilities Security Tools Operations and Validation deploys, runs, and validates the security technologies that defend the company's infrastructure and products. Having tools is not enough. We continuously validate that they work as intended, and keep pace with an evolving security environment. You will build, scale, and validate security defenses alongside engineering, infrastructure, and cyber teams, work that directly improves our security posture and protects the company and its users. The mission of TikTok's Global Security Organization is to build and earn trust by reducing risk and securing our businesses and products. Also known as "GSO", this team is the foundation of our efforts to keep TikTok safe, secure, and operating at scale for over 1 billion people around the world. We work to ensure that the TikTok platform is safe and secure, that our users' experience and their data remains safe from external or internal threats, and that we comply with global regulations wherever TikTok operates. Trust is one of TikTok's biggest initiatives, and security is integral to our success. In whatever ways users interact with us — whether they're watching videos on their For You page, interacting with a Live video, or buying products on TikTok Shop — GSO protects their data and privacy, so they can have a secure and trustworthy experience. The Enterprise to Edge Security team sits within the SecOps Validation Team (STOV) and builds the tools and technologies that protect TikTok infrastructure. You will join a team that works across enterprise systems, endpoints, cloud, email infrastructure, data centers, networks, and CDN environments, and you will not be expected to know all of them on day one. What matters here is curiosity about how modern, AI\-driven systems are built and how to keep them secure. You will learn on the job alongside experienced engineers, contribute to real security controls and tooling, and grow the breadth of your infrastructure security skills over time. If you understand AI concepts and security fundamentals and want to build and secure with us, this role is built for you. \- Learn how security controls are designed, implemented, and validated across cloud and infrastructure environments, with hands\-on mentoring from engineers. \- Help build, test, and maintain security tooling and automation, including scripts that support validation, observability, and enforcement. \- Support threat modeling, architecture reviews, and security assessments for services that increasingly use AI and machine learning components. \- Explore how AI can improve security work, such as assisted analysis, automated detection, and faster validation, and help prototype those ideas. \- Contribute to infrastructure\-as\-code and policy\-as\-code workflows that enforce security baselines and reduce configuration drift. \- Document your work, share what you learn with the team, and gradually take ownership of well\-scoped projects end to end. Qualifications **Minimum Qualifications:** \- Understanding of core AI and machine learning concepts, such as how models are trained and used, common data and model risks, and why securing AI systems differs from securing traditional applications. \- Grasp of security fundamentals, for example authentication and access control, common vulnerabilities, encryption basics, and the principle of least privilege. \- Basic programming or scripting ability in any language, such as Python, Go, JavaScript, or Java, and a willingness to deepen it. \- Familiarity with at least one modern technology area, such as a cloud platform, Linux systems, networking, containers, CI/CD pipelines, or data engineering. Exposure to one area is enough; you do not need to be an all\-round cloud expert. \- Strong problem\-solving habits, clear communication, and the motivation to learn new technologies quickly in a fast\-moving environment. Preferred Qualifications: \- A degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience through coursework, bootcamps, internships, or self\-directed learning. \- Internship, project, or lab experience involving security, cloud infrastructure, AI/ML pipelines, or developer tooling. \- Any exposure to a major cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, GCP, or OCI, or to containers and Kubernetes. \- Entry\-level security or cloud certifications, such as CompTIA Security\+, CC, or a cloud provider fundamentals credential. Certifications are optional and never a substitute for practical curiosity. \- Experience using AI\-assisted development or data tools, and an opinion on where AI helps and where it introduces new risk. Job Information 【For Pay Transparency】Compensation Description (Annually) The base salary range for this position in the selected city is $87400 \- $134400 annually. ​ Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units. ​ Benefits may vary depending on the nature of employment and the country work location. Employees have day one access to medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) savings plan with company match, paid parental leave, short\-term and long\-term disability coverage, life insurance, wellbeing benefits, among others. Employees also receive 10 paid holidays per year, 10 paid sick days per year and 17 days of Paid Personal Time (prorated upon hire with increasing accruals by tenure). ​ The Company reserves the right to modify or change these benefits programs at any time, with or without notice. ​ **For Los Angeles County (unincorporated) Candidates:** ​ Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Interacting and occasionally having unsupervised contact with internal/external clients and/or colleagues; ​ 2\. Appropriately handling and managing confidential information including proprietary and trade secret information and access to information technology systems; and ​ 3\. Exercising sound judgment. ​ About TikTok TikTok is the leading destination for short\-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo. ​ Why Join Us Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy \- a mission we work towards every day. ​ We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. jobs.title: Sustaining Engineer, Power Electronics
jobs.description: **About Tritium** Tritium has spent more than 20 years building the power electronics behind DC fast charging, with over 3 GW deployed across 50\+ countries. Our Lebanon, Tennessee facility builds our chargers for the North American market, and it's gearing up to produce our new FLEX family, including DC\-FLEX for fleet and workplace charging and GRID\-FLEX, which supplies 800 VDC power for fleet depots, data centers and DC microgrids. **About the role** We're building out our engineering team in Tennessee, and this is a new role for an engineer who wants to own real products in production. call for electrical and power electronics issues on the production line and at end\-of\-line test * Troubleshoot PCBAs, power modules, harnesses and high\-voltage DC systems to get production moving again quickly and safely * Lead root cause analysis on production failures, field returns and warranty claims, and drive corrective actions with Quality and suppliers * Manage engineering change orders and keep BOMs accurate * Qualify alternate components when parts are scarce or obsolete * Support our Technical Support Engineers on complex field failures, and feed what you learn back to the design team * Find yield, cost and manufacturability improvements on released products **What you'll bring** * A bachelor's degree in Electrical or Electronics Engineering, or a closely related field * 3 to 7 years of experience with power electronics or high\-power electrical hardware in a production, sustaining or manufacturing engineering environment * Hands\-on troubleshooting with oscilloscopes, power analyzers, hipot and other test equipment * Confidence reading schematics, PCB layouts, wiring diagrams and BOMs * Experience with structured root cause analysis (8D, 5 Whys) and engineering change control * Sound high\-voltage safety practices (for example NFPA 70E) * Clear communication with teams across sites and time zones * Bonus points for experience in EV charging, solar inverters, energy storage, UPS or motor drives, UL safety standards, SiC or IGBT devices, or taking over products from a design team **Why Tritium?** * Own industry\-leading power electronics that are shaping the future of EV charging and wider energy infrastructure * Get in early on a new product family and help shape how it's built in Tennessee * Work with engineering teams in the US and Australia * Competitive salary and benefits ### **Company Overview** Please visit https://tritiumcharging.com/ for more information

As a regional marine science and technology resource, FIO provides access to research vessels, specialized marine equipment, field operations expertise, and the Keys Marine Laboratory to support discovery, student learning, environmental stewardship, and solutions to complex coastal and ocean challenges. Through its vessels, facilities, and experienced maritime professionals, FIO enables researchers, students, agencies, and industry partners to conduct work on, in, and around the water safely and effectively. FIO supports oceanographic research while also serving as a broader platform for interdisciplinary education, experiential learning, marine technology testing, public\-private collaboration, and workforce development. As part of USF, FIO strengthens the university’s role as a leader in ocean science, coastal resilience, and marine innovation while serving the needs of Florida and the broader ocean community. **Position Description:** The Research Vessel Captain / Marine Captain serves as the senior vessel authority and is responsible for the safe, compliant, effective, and mission\-ready operation of assigned FIO uninspected research vessels. The position exercises command authority over vessel operations, crew, embarked personnel, students, researchers, vessel users, and mission activities while underway, alongside, and during mobilization and demobilization. The Captain is responsible for navigation, piloting, voyage planning, vessel readiness, crew supervision, deck operations, mission execution, emergency preparedness, safety management, regulatory compliance, scientific mission support, vessel documentation, budget and procurement support, vendor coordination, and communication with FIO leadership, research users, port authorities, regulatory agencies, and external partners. The updated role is broader than traditional vessel operation. The Captain functions as an operational manager for a mobile university research platform and is responsible for integrating maritime safety, research mission requirements, personnel management, risk controls, logistics, vessel maintenance coordination, scientific equipment deployment, and administrative reporting. The position requires independent judgment and decision\-making in dynamic maritime environments, including remote operations, adverse weather, nighttime operations, emergency situations, research deployment evolutions, and multi\-day expeditions. This position will report directly to the Manager Marine Operations on the USF St. Petersburg campus. **Command, Navigation, Vessel Operations, and Mission Execution.** Serve as Captain and senior authority aboard assigned FIO research vessels. Operate, pilot, navigate, and command vessels in port, near\-coastal waters, offshore waters, restricted waterways, anchorages, and research operating areas. Maintain responsibility for the safety and welfare of all embarked personnel, including crew, students, faculty, researchers, agency personnel, contractors, and guests. jobs.title: Frontend Software Engineer, Personal Loans
jobs.description: **About Upstart** At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence. As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress. We’re proudly digital\-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80\+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital\-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in\-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in\-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you. If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you. **The Team:** Unsecured Installments is one of Upstart's core lending products, helping borrowers access credit through a seamless, digitally native experience. The team owns critical parts of the borrower journey across offer generation, pricing, underwriting, funding, and borrower experience, while working closely with the broader lending platform that powers Upstart at scale. Recent work has focused on improving borrower flows, repricing and rate flexibility, partnership experiences, and the overall quality of the customer\-facing experience. As a Senior Software Engineer on the Unsecured Installments team, you'll be a technical leader for the frontend and full\-stack experiences that borrowers interact with directly. Working primarily in React and TypeScript, you'll own the delivery of large, multi\-month projects, shape the architecture of the team's mobile\-web and full\-stack surfaces, and set a high bar for quality across the borrower experience. make an impact** * Own the design and delivery of large, complex frontend initiatives using React and TypeScript, from planning and sequencing through launch and long\-term maintenance. * Set technical direction for the team's frontend architecture, owning a 3–6 month roadmap and proactively addressing systemic gaps that threaten team effectiveness. * Partner closely with product, design, and backend engineers to translate roadmap priorities and borrower needs into scalable, high\-quality experiences. * Raise the bar for engineering excellence through strong component and API design, thoughtful state management, testing, observability, and operational rigor across borrower\-facing surfaces. * Lead through ambiguity, breaking down loosely defined problems into clear, testable plans and using data to inform tradeoffs on scope, performance, and user experience. * Mentor and grow other engineers through code reviews, design reviews, and technical guidance, and serve as a trusted collaborator across the team. * Contribute to how the team uses AI in development workflows and product capabilities, with a pragmatic view of where it can create meaningful leverage. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience) and 4\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * Deep proficiency building complex web applications with React and TypeScript, including component architecture, state management, performance optimization, and consuming REST or GraphQL APIs. * Track record of independently leading the design and delivery of large, business\-critical frontend projects in production. * Ability to work effectively in ambiguous environments where product requirements, constraints, and system boundaries evolve over time. * Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs and align product, design, and engineering partners. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building consumer\-facing products at scale with strong attention to performance, accessibility, and user experience. * Background in fintech, lending, payments, or other regulated financial products with complex user journeys and high quality Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” Here’s what you can expect: * Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly * Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada) * Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only) * Comprehensive health coverage designed to support you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and wellness resources for US and supplemental health coverage for Canada. * Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart for eligible plans (US only) * Income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security * Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements * Paid family and parental leave to support caregiving and major life moments (duration varies by country) * Family\-centered benefits to support fertility, parenthood, and caregiving needs * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering mental health support and life\-centered resources * Financial wellness resources, including access to financial planning tools and a financial concierge service (US Only) * Annual wellness allowance to support your physical and emotional well\-being and personal development, based on what matters most to you * Annual productivity allowance to invest in relevant tools and resources you need to do your best work, no matter where you work from * Connection and community through team events, all\-company updates, and employee resource groups (ERGs) * Onsite perks, including catered lunches and fully stocked micro\-kitchens when working from one of our offices in the Bay Area, Austin, Columbus, and New York City For roles based in Canada, please note that we are not currently able to hire in Quebec. jobs.title: Machine Learning Researcher - Seismic Foundation Models
jobs.description: Viridien ( www.viridiengroup.com ) is an advanced technology, digital and Earth data company that pushes the boundaries of science for a more prosperous and sustainable future. With our ingenuity, drive and deep curiosity we discover new insights, innovations, and solutions that efficiently and responsibly resolve complex natural resource, digital, energy transition and infrastructure challenges. **Job details:** **The role** Viridien, a leader in subsurface imaging, has been building seismic foundation models: models that learn representations of the subsurface from one of the largest, highest\-quality proprietary seismic data in the industry, and that adapt to many downstream interpretation and imaging tasks with few labels or zero\-shot. These models are primarily vision\-oriented, treating seismic data as volumetric image data, and we are increasingly exploring multimodal extensions that incorporate additional data types such as well logs, velocity models and geological metadata. The central research challenge is not simply to train larger models, but to determine what the model learns, where it fails, and how to improve its ability to generalize across surveys, geological settings and downstream tasks. Rigorous understanding of what the model learns and where it generalizes is precisely how we earn a model reliable enough to trust on unseen surveys in production. You will work at the intersection of ML research and seismic imaging production, with access to that proprietary dataset and to substantial on\-prem GPU capacity. You will own research hypotheses, model implementations and controlled experiments, working closely with geophysicists and geoscience specialists. No prior seismic expertise is required: our geoscientists will support you in building the domain knowledge you need. We welcome strong early\-career researchers as well as more experienced ones, with or without a PhD.. Scientific rigor matters more to us than years of experience. **What you do** * Advance understanding of what a seismic foundation model learns, where it fails, and how to improve its generalization across surveys and geological settings. * Design, implement and improve model architecture, pre\-training objectives and training\-data strategies. * Establish generalization on independent seismic surveys against meaningful benchmarks and help define the evaluation protocol. * Diagnose model limitations and work with our ML engineers and geoscience specialists to improve reliability. **Required** * PhD (completed or near completion) in geophysics, applied mathematics, physics, computer science or a related quantitative field, or equivalent demonstrated research experience (e.g., a strong publication or open\-source research record, or substantial research work in industry). * Demonstrated depth in computer vision, including vision transformers and self\-supervised or representation learning for image or volumetric data, with the ability to justify training objectives and evaluation methods for scientific signal or image data. * Evidence of strong scientific problem\-solving: forming testable hypotheses, designing controlled experiments, interpreting results critically, and learning from approaches that do not work. * Strong hands\-on PyTorch skills: implementing, debugging and evaluating research models, with experience optimizing training for limited GPU memory and compute. * Ability to collaborate with geoscience specialists and to communicate technical assumptions and limitations clearly. **Preferred (a plus, not required)** * Experience with large\-scale or distributed (multi\-GPU / multi\-node) training and the data pipelines it depends on. * Experience with multimodal learning or cross\-modal representation alignment. * Prior exposure to seismic, geophysical or other scientific imaging data * Experience taking research models toward production or deployment. * Publications at strong machine\-learning or scientific venues, or meaningful open\-source contributions. * Familiarity with foundation\-model pre\-training at scale. **What we offer** * Access to one of the largest, highest\-quality proprietary seismic datasets in the industry. * Substantial dedicated on\-prem GPU capacity. * A genuine research mandate to turn advanced FWI imaging into actionable exploration insights and drilling prospects. **Houston Benefits:** * 401k Retirement Plan \- when you contribute up to 5%, not only will we match that, but we will also add an additional 2% * Free on\-site fitness centre offering group exercise classes * Short\-term disability and long\-term disability coverage at no cost to you * Parental Leave Program allowing mothers and fathers to take time off from work for childbirth, adoption and to bond with your new child * Pet Insurance – options to meet every budget Wellness Program – resources provided to support your personal wellness and participation in activities can earn you $65 quarterly. * **Our Hiring Process** At Viridien, we are committed to delivering a respectful, inclusive, and transparent recruitment experience. Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to provide individual feedback to every applicant. Only candidates whose qualifications closely match the role criteria will be contacted for an interview. We do, however, aim to share personalized feedback with those who progress to the first round of interviews and beyond. We are also dedicated to ensuring that our hiring process accessible to all. If you require any reasonable adjustments to fully participate in the application or interview stages, please don’t hesitate to contact your recruiter directly. We see things differently. Diversity fuels our innovation, we value the unique ways in which we differ, and we are committed to equal employment opportunities for all professionals.

jobs.title: Telematics Application Developer
jobs.description: **Wanco Inc. is seeking a Telematics Application Developer in our Arvada, CO production facility.** **Position Summary** Wanco is hiring an onsite Telematics Developer, reporting to the Director of Technology, to take over and grow the Telematics Device Manager, an internal web application that tracks telematics modems, their SIMs and carrier service, the platforms they are installed in, and the customers and sales orders they belong to. The app is used daily and manages about 27,000 devices. It integrates with Verizon, Plex ERP, and the modems themselves. It is also the starting point for Project Telematics, Wanco’s Connected Asset Management Platform: one authoritative, hardware\-agnostic record of every connected Wanco device — its asset, cellular service, data usage and health — with the ability to act on it from one place. The business goals are lower cellular spend, faster troubleshooting and provisioning, and a foundation for future connected\-product offerings. This is a full\-stack role on a roughly 30,000\-line codebase: React 18 and TypeScript on the front end, Node/Express and PostgreSQL 15 on the back end, deployed with Docker Compose and nginx. You will become the primary owner. This position is 100% onsite at Wanco’s Arvada, Colorado headquarters; remote work is not available. You will also work side by side with Wanco’s AI Implementation Specialist, supporting the software development needed to put AI tools and automation into use across the business, alongside your work on the Telematics Device Manager. This is an existing, actively used production application with a solid foundation, relied on by the operations team to manage cellular and telematics devices across Wanco’s fleet of trailers and equipment, tied to customers, sales orders and multiple wireless carriers. You will maintain it, extend it, and help shape where it goes next, including the SIM card and platform management features on the roadmap and hardening the app for scale. It is early enough in its life that there is real room to refactor, add tests, and set conventions that will stick. You will also be the technical voice for the platform as it moves through Wanco’s stage\-gate process, helping shape its architecture, the build\-versus\-buy decision, and the release roadmap. **Key Responsibilities** **Application Ownership \& Support** * Own day\-to\-day support of the application: fix bugs, answer user questions, and keep dev and production healthy. * Build and maintain features across the React/TypeScript front end and the Express/PostgreSQL back end, including sales order validation and customer address handling, plus device, container and vendor management. * Keep dependencies and the Node runtime current, and write automated tests where none exist today. * Support PDF and label generation (device labels, barcodes), and maintain documentation in the README and Confluence, and work with IT on integrations such as Entra SSO. **Carrier, ERP \& Device Integrations** * Maintain the abstracted service\-provider layer and carrier integrations (currently Verizon ThingSpace, through a Node REST client plus a Python SDK script, and Granite), including authentication, status syncing and suspend/unsuspend workflows, and the Plex Connect integration for sales orders and customers. * Maintain and extend the MicroHard and InHand modem drivers, which push configuration over HTTP/S and are timing\-sensitive (a push takes 3\.5 to 9 minutes). * Finish the Granite integration by moving the existing standalone Python scripts into the server and completing the open design work. * Keep the data model hardware\-agnostic and carrier\-neutral, so new modem, tracker and router models (for example, InHand or Samsara) and new carriers can be added through a documented adapter interface without redesigning core workflows. **Data, Jobs \& Infrastructure** * Own the PostgreSQL schema and its evolution as new device types and carriers are added, including bringing the base schema file up to date and tracking which migrations have run in each environment. * Improve and run the scheduled background jobs (nightly device status sync, usage polling) and the job queue, and add monitoring and alerting for failures. * Maintain the Docker dev, test and production environments and the GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline (automatic deploys to dev, manual workflow to production), the nightly database backup, and the TLS certificate, working with IT. * Import and reconcile Wanco’s existing device, SIM and line records from spreadsheets, Verizon account exports and vendor portals, and report records that cannot be matched to an asset. **Connected Asset Management Platform (Project Telematics)** * Turn the approved business requirements and user stories into working software, starting with launch\-critical items: one record per device, search by any identifier (asset number, VIN, serial number, IMEI, ICCID, phone number or tracker ID), provisioning state tracking, scheduled  \+ years of professional full\-stack web development. * Strong JavaScript and TypeScript, including React 18 with Vite and building typed API clients. * Node.js and Express: REST API design, session authentication (Passport), and role\-based access control. * PostgreSQL and hand\-written SQL (the app uses no ORM): schema design, migrations, connection pooling, indexing, and query tuning on tables with tens of thousands of rows. * Docker and Docker Compose across dev, test and production environments, nginx, and Linux server administration. * Git and a GitFlow\-style workflow (feature branches to dev to main) with CI/CD through GitHub Actions. * Experience integrating third\-party REST APIs and handling quirky authentication, timeouts, rate limits and failures. * Comfort taking over an existing codebase with little test coverage and light documentation, then improving it safely, including helping build a test suite. Self\-directed and comfortable owning features end\-to\-end on a small team. * Willingness to collaborate closely with a non\-developer or AI\-focused colleague, turning their requirements and prototypes into production code and explaining technical tradeoffs clearly. * Ability to explain status, risks and tradeoffs in plain language to non\-technical stakeholders in Operations, Finance, Service and leadership. * Able to work onsite at Wanco’s Arvada, Colorado headquarters every working day; this role is not remote. **Preferred Qualifications** * Python, for the Verizon ThingSpace SDK script and the Granite scripts. * Experience with IoT, telematics, cellular modems or SIM and carrier management platforms. * Familiarity with Verizon ThingSpace, Plex (Rockwell Automation) Connect, or similar ERP and carrier APIs. * Experience with carrier usage and billing data, pooled data plans, or cellular cost analytics. * Device or network configuration over HTTP/S, such as MicroHard or InHand industrial modems. * Familiarity with telematics data standards such as AEMP 2\.0 (ISO 15143\-3\) or FHWA’s Work Zone Data Exchange (WZDx). * Experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) single sign\-on using OIDC or SAML. * Background jobs and scheduling: queue design, SKIP LOCKED patterns, cron, and parallel processing. * Application security practice: dependency auditing, safe file upload parsing, and secrets handling. * Test automation with Vitest, Jest or Playwright, and linting and type\-checking in CI. * Background in fleet management, logistics, or manufacturing software. * Tailwind CSS. * Experience with WSL or other Linux\-based development environments. * Programmatic PDF and barcode generation with pdfkit, bwip\-js or similar. * Experience integrating AI services, such as LLM APIs, into applications, including prompt and tool\-call workflows, retrieval, and handling cost, latency and data privacy. * Experience building automations or data pipelines that connect business systems. **Physical Requirements** * Primarily office\-based at Wanco’s Arvada headquarters, working at a computer for extended periods. * Occasional time on the production floor and equipment yard to work with technicians on modem installation, configuration and troubleshooting on trailers and equipment; required to wear PPE when in those areas. * Occasionally lift up to 25 lbs (modems, routers and test equipment). * Occasional after\-hours support may be needed for production issues or scheduled deployments. **Reporting:** This position reports to the Director of Technology and has no direct reports **Salary Range:** $75,000 \- $125,000 per year based on qualifications. **FLSA Status:** Exempt, Full\-Time **Benefits**: Insurance (Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, 401k). Paid time off and holidays. **Wanco Inc.** Address: 5870 Tennyson Street, Arvada, CO 80003 \| wanco.com Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $125,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer – Authentication Security
jobs.description: **Your work days are brighter here.** We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too. **About the Team** At Workday, trust and security are foundational to everything we do. The Authentication Security team builds and operates the platform that is the front door to Workday. We provide a secure, resilient, unified authentication platform that evaluates a user’s identity and access across the Workday suite and protects millions of users. We own authentication services, the Authentication Gateway, and Workday Central Login. The work spans: Sign\-on and federation: username and password, SAML, OpenID Connect, and OAuth single sign\-on Strong authentication: passwordless authentication (FIDO2/WebAuthn), multi\-factor authentication, and step\-up verification Sessions and devices: session and token management, trusted devices, and delegated and mobile login You will partner with Product and with teams across the identity and authentication stack to design, build, and operate these flows. **About the Role** We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to build and test authentication features with guidance from senior engineers. You will turn product and security requirements into working services, APIs, and tests on the live authentication platform. **About You** **Basic Qualifications** ------------------------ * BS/MS in Computer Science (or equivalent practical experience) and 2\+ years of professional backend software development experience. * 2\+ years of experience programming in Java and/or Scala. * 1\+ year of experience developing and maintaining RESTful APIs in production environments. * Experience applying object\-oriented design (OOD) principles and design patterns in backend codebases. Experience writing automated tests (unit or integration) for backend service. * **Qualifying (Preferred) Qualifications** * Hands\-on experience with Spring Boot (for Java) or the Play framework (for Scala), and a willingness to learn the other language on the job. * Practical experience implementing OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, or multi\-factor authentication flows. * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (such as Jenkins) and deploying code into live production environments. * Experience using AI coding assistants paired with thorough code review, security validation, and testing habits. What You Will Bring · Experience supporting production network, infrastructure, application\-delivery, or load\-balancing services in a controlled enterprise environment. · Ability to troubleshoot application connectivity, TCP/IP, DNS, TLS/certificates, health checks, traffic behavior, and high\-availability issues. · Experience with incident response, escalation, configuration management, patching, monitoring, and formal change control. · Ability to write clear runbooks and incident records, coordinate service restoration, and transfer operational knowledge to customer staff. · Prior experience supporting a federal agency as a contractor, including Government coordination, security/access requirements, documentation, and change\-control procedures. Preferred Experience · Direct VA experience, particularly VA Office of Information and Technology infrastructure support, is strongly preferred and a significant selection factor. · Hands\-on NetScaler/Citrix ADC or comparable enterprise load\-balancer operations, including Tier 2/3 troubleshooting, upgrades, HA failover, GSLB, and certificate management. · Federal or FISMA High environments; infrastructure automation; configuration backup/recovery; centralized logging, monitoring, or identity integration. · Relevant platform, networking, or operations certifications. Education Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in information technology, networking, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent directly relevant experience. Production Incident Targets The team supports the following platform\-attributable incident targets under approved escalation procedures. Resolution and restoration are subject to the contract’s applicable provisions, including approved workarounds and dependency\-related pauses. · Severity 1 Critical: 15\-minute response; four\-hour resolution or Government\-approved workaround restoring business functionality. · Severity 2 High: one\-hour response; eight\-hour resolution. · Severity 3 Medium: four\-hour response; one\-business\-day resolution. · Severity 4 Low: one\-business\-day response; five\-business\-day resolution. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, YouTube Ads Experiences
jobs.description: In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. * 8 years of experience in software development. * 5 years of experience with ML design and ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, data processing, debugging, fine tuning). * 5 years of experience testing, and launching software products, and 3 years of experience with software design and architecture. * Experience integrating generative AI tools or Large Language Model (LLM) interfaces into workflows. * Experience applying AI (Gemini, GenAI, LLM) towards solving real\-world technical problems. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. * 8 years of experience with data structures and algorithms. * 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction. * 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross\-functional, or cross\-business projects. **About the job** ----------------- Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward. As a part of the YouTube Ads Experiences (YTAX) team, you will join a core, horizontal engineering group responsible for the DNA of the YouTube user experience. You will build the experiences and interactions that power YouTube’s ecosystem across major surfaces and interfaces. In this role, your mission is to balance user experience with high\-value advertiser outcomes. You will build patterns that scale globally, ensure the financial health of the YouTube creator community and advertiser values by delivering long\-term business annually. Google Ads is at the forefront of AI innovation, applying cutting\-edge machine learning and Generative AI models like Gemini to power a multi\-billion dollar global business. Our work directly impacts billions of users by protecting users from harm, improving ad quality, and optimizing campaigns for advertiser return\-on\-investment. We foster a culture of deep collaboration, partnering closely with teams like Google Research and DeepMind to solve complex challenges. Join us to work on state\-of\-the\-art AI, take on problems at an unparalleled scale, and build the next generation of advertising technology. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $207000 \- $300000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Facilitate alignment and clarity across teams on goals, outcomes, and timelines, and influence and coach a distributed team of engineers. * Leverage AI strategically to solve complex layout and interaction problems, using it or not for its own sake but to build smarter, more adaptive products. * Partner directly with YouTube’s "Organic" product teams to re\-envision the app experience, going beyond simply adding ads by helping build step\-function changes to how users interact with the YouTube App. * Lead the effort to reduce friction between an ad and its destination, owning the full\-stack, from deep infrastructure and foundation layers to the application\-level UI. * Drive the next\-generation of ad experiences, especially on Consumption Surfaces (Watch, and Shorts surfaces, account for 87% YT ads revenue), by optimizing existing inventory and innovating new experiences to meet evolving user and advertiser needs. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Our AI recruiting agent sources and vets domain experts for our data platform that enables rapid production of high\-quality training data. We believe a small team of exceptional lawyers, supported by powerful AI agents and purpose\-built technology, can operate at a scale and speed that traditional legal departments cannot. You’ll work directly with our General Counsel, legal team, and engineering team to identify legal problems, design and build AI\-powered solutions, and continuously improve how legal work gets done. Partner with our legal and operations teams to develop rigorous evaluations, test cases, and quality standards that reflect our legal team’s judgment, preferences, and risk tolerance. You love experimenting, prototyping, testing, and iterating. You’re excited to be personally involved in building solutions, not just managing projects or vendors. * AI fluency and technical curiosity. You’re deeply engaged with emerging AI capabilities and excited to explore what they make possible. Coding experience is a plus, not a requirement. * High agency and ownership. It doesn’t need to involve writing code or be a polished, production\-ready product. We want to understand the problem you identified, how you approached solving it, what you personally built, and how you evaluated whether it worked. We’re much more interested in your creativity, problem\-solving ability, and enthusiasm for building than the sophistication of the underlying technology. **Compensation \& Benefits Notice** The national pay range for this full\-time position is base salary of $215,000 –$230,000\. This role will lead the evolution of our cloud automation strategy while continuing to modernize hybrid infrastructure operations . The role will also help mature automation for physical server build and lifecycle processes using tooling and practices such as unattended deployment, imaging, configuration management, patching, remote administration, and hardware lifecycle orchestration. **Key Responsibilities*** Design, implement, and maintain scalable cloud Infrastructure as Code (IaC) frameworks using Terraform, Spacelift, and Ansible across AWS and Alibaba Cloud. * Develop reusable Terraform modules, Ansible roles, workflow templates, and automation pipelines that enable standardized, self\-service hybrid infrastructure provisioning and platform scalability. * Support and automate cloud\-native services and application hosting platforms, including ECS, ECR, S3, ALB, and equivalent Alibaba Cloud services. * Build and improve end\-to\-end provisioning workflows for both virtualized and bare metal infrastructure, including infrastructure provisioning, operating system deployment, post\-build configuration, patching, and ongoing lifecycle management. * Automate bare metal server deployment and rebuild processes using tools and methods such as unattended installations, imaging platforms, PXE\-based workflows, configuration management, and remote administration tooling. * Develop and maintain automation for Windows server configuration and compliance using tools such as Ansible, PowerShell, DSC, WinRM, and related platform\-management capabilities. * Support infrastructure provisioning workflows across VMware/vSphere where applicable, including API\-driven resource creation and post\-provisioning configuration. * Partner with Infrastructure, Security, TradeOps, and application teams to translate operational requirements into well\-governed automation patterns. * Improve the reliability of infrastructure delivery by implementing validation, testing, code review, rollback, and change\-control mechanisms. * Develop controls to detect and remediate configuration drift across environments and ensure infrastructure remains aligned to approved code and standards. * Troubleshoot failures across Terraform, Ansible, Windows/Linux automation, bare metal provisioning workflows, Spacelift, VMware, and cloud automation workflows, and continuously improve operational resilience. * Document automation patterns, operational runbooks, and implementation standards so solutions are supportable and transferable across the team. * Identify high\-value manual processes suitable for automation and prioritize work based on operational impact, risk reduction, and scalability. **Success Measures*** Reduction in manual hybrid infrastructure provisioning and change activity. * Faster, more reliable delivery of server and cloud infrastructure changes. * Increased infrastructure coverage under source control and automated workflows. * Reduced configuration drift and improved auditability of infrastructure state. * Improved quality, maintainability, and reuse of infrastructure code across clients and environments. **Required Qualifications*** 5\+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, systems engineering, DevOps, platform engineering, or infrastructure automation roles. * Proven experience designing and operating Infrastructure as Code in complex hybrid environments. * Strong hands\-on experience with **Terraform**, **Ansible**, and automation orchestration platforms such as **Spacelift**. * Strong experience automating **Windows/Linux server provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management** across both virtualized and physical environments. * Hands\-on experience with **bare metal automation**, including one or more of the following: unattended OS deployment, PXE or network boot workflows, imaging systems, configuration management, remote administration tooling, patch orchestration, or hardware provisioning processes. * Experience with tools and technologies such as **PowerShell, WinRM, MDT/WDS or equivalent deployment tooling**, and related Windows automation frameworks. * Experience with virtualization platforms such as **VMware/vSphere**, including API\-driven provisioning and infrastructure automation. * Strong hands\-on experience with public cloud infrastructure, especially **AWS**, including services such as **ECS, ECR, S3, and ALB**, and related cloud building blocks for application hosting, storage, and traffic management. * Experience with **Alibaba Cloud**, or equivalent experience translating AWS\-based infrastructure patterns into comparable Alibaba Cloud services. * Proficiency in one or more scripting/programming languages such as **Python**, **PowerShell**, or **Bash**. * Solid understanding of Git\-based workflows, branching strategies, pull requests, and CI/CD concepts. * Strong understanding of operational risk, security controls, secrets handling, and change governance in infrastructure automation. * Strong problem\-solving skills, sound engineering judgment, and the ability to work independently in a fast\-moving environment. * Excellent communication skills with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications*** Experience supporting containerized application platforms and related cloud services, including container registries, object storage, load balancers, and deployment patterns in **AWS** and Alibaba Cloud. * Experience building or supporting standardized bare metal server factories or repeatable provisioning pipelines for physical infrastructure. * Experience with policy enforcement, drift detection, and automated compliance in IaC pipelines. * Experience with GitHub\-based infrastructure workflows. * Experience with observability and operational tooling such as DataDog, Tenable, Automox, or related infrastructure support platforms . * Experience with containerization or Kubernetes. * Experience working in regulated, high\-availability, or client\-segmented environments. * Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Terraform Associate, Ansible\-related certifications, or equivalent. **What Great Looks Like** The right person for this role is not just a script writer. They are an infrastructure engineer who can assess a manual process, define a durable technical pattern, implement it safely in code, and leave behind something that is testable, supportable, and scalable. They are comfortable operating across cloud platforms, infrastructure pipelines, virtualization, operating systems, networking, security controls, and server lifecycle automation. They care about long\-term maintainability as much as initial delivery. The base salary range for this role is $130,000\- 165,000, depending on relevant experience. Eligible for an incentive bonus.
